questions.explanation: 「Does she is happy」錯誤地把助動詞 Does 與 be 動詞 is 混用。正確應為 Is she happy today?。be 動詞句不可加 do/does 構成疑問。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: be 動詞與一般動詞現在式
questions.stem: 【應用題】下列哪個問句與回答「配對正確」？
options: Are you like ice cream? — Yes, I am.
Do you a student? — Yes, I do.
Does Tom have a dog? — Yes, he does.
Is she plays the piano? — Yes, she is.
questions.explanation: 選項 C 問句用 Does + 原形動詞（have），回答 Yes, he does. 完全正確。A 應用 Do you like；B 應用 Are you；D 應用 Does she play（Is 不可搭配一般動詞）。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: be 動詞與一般動詞現在式
questions.stem:
【情境題】Tom 描述他和朋友的週末活動。請選出正確的句子。
Tom and his friend _____ the park on Sundays, but the park _____ open on rainy days.
questions.explanation: 「Tom and his friend」是複數主詞，一般動詞用原形 visit（不加 s）；「the park」是單數，be 動詞否定用 isn't。需分辨兩個主詞的單複數。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: be 動詞與一般動詞現在式
questions.stem:
【變化題】以下哪一句中，底線動詞形式「正確」？
(A) She teach math and science.
(B) He don't eat breakfast.
(C) The baby cries when it is hungry.
(D) They doesn't go to school on Sundays.
options: The baby cries when it is hungry.
They doesn't go to school on Sundays.
questions.explanation: 「The baby」是第三人稱單數，cry 變化為 cries（子音 + y → ies）。A 應為 teaches；B 應為 doesn't eat；D 應為 don't go（They 是複數）。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: be 動詞與一般動詞現在式
questions.stem:
【辨析題】老師要求同學把否定句改為正確形式，下列哪一個「改法正確」？
原句：She is not play the guitar.
options: She doesn't is play the guitar.
She is not plays the guitar.
questions.explanation: 原句混用了 is 和 play，結構錯誤。play 是一般動詞，否定句應使用 doesn't + 原形動詞，不加 be 動詞。正確句為 She doesn't play the guitar.

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: be 動詞與一般動詞現在式
questions.stem:
【情境題】請閱讀以下對話，選出正確答案。
A: What does your father do?
B: He _____ a doctor. He _____ at the city hospital.
questions.explanation: 「What does your father do?」問職業，回答用 be 動詞：He is a doctor.；描述工作地點「works」是一般動詞，主詞 He 為第三人稱單數，加 -s。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: be 動詞與一般動詞現在式
questions.stem:
【應用題】學校英語考卷上有一題克漏字，請選出「全部正確」的選項。
My grandparents _____(1)_____ in Tainan. My grandfather _____(2)_____ every morning, and my grandmother _____(3)_____ the garden every day.
questions.explanation: 「My grandparents」是複數，動詞用原形 live；「My grandfather / my grandmother」均為第三人稱單數，動詞須加 -s：exercises、waters（water 作動詞表「澆水」）。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: be 動詞與一般動詞現在式
questions.stem:
【易混淆辨析題】下列哪個句子的疑問句形式「正確」？
原句：Your cat sleeps on the sofa.
options: Is your cat sleeps on the sofa?
Do your cat sleep on the sofa?
Does your cat sleeps on the sofa?
Does your cat sleep on the sofa?
questions.explanation: 一般動詞疑問句：第三人稱單數用 Does，動詞須還原為原形（sleep，不加 s）。選項 C 的 sleeps 保留了 -s，是常見錯誤。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: be 動詞與一般動詞現在式
questions.stem:
【情境題】請選出下列對話中語意與文法皆正確的回答。
A: Is your sister a nurse or a teacher?
B: _____
questions.explanation: 這是 be 動詞的選擇疑問句（A or B），回答須使用 be 動詞，選出其中一個。She is a teacher. 是唯一語意與結構均正確的回答。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: be 動詞與一般動詞現在式
questions.stem: 【變化題】David 的老師要同學描述班上同學的習慣，哪個句子「完全正確」？
options: Nobody in our class don't bring a lunch box.
Everyone in our class brings a lunch box.
All of my classmates brings a lunch box.
Each of my classmates bring a lunch box.
questions.explanation: Everyone 視為單數，動詞加 -s（brings）。All of my classmates 是複數，應用 bring。Each of + 複數名詞視為單數，應用 brings。Nobody 不與 don't 連用（雙重否定錯誤）。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: be 動詞與一般動詞現在式
questions.stem:
【辨析題】以下哪個句子中，括號內的動詞形式「需要改變」才正確？
(A) I (am) not a morning person.
(B) Ken and Lisa (are) good friends.
(C) My dog (don't) like baths.
(D) She (doesn't) know the answer.
options: I am not a morning person.
Ken and Lisa are good friends.
questions.explanation: 「My dog」是第三人稱單數，否定助動詞應用 doesn't，而非 don't。正確句為 My dog doesn't like baths.。其他三句文法均正確。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: be 動詞與一般動詞現在式
questions.stem:
【應用題】下列短文中，第幾個底線處有文法錯誤？
My cousin _(1)_lives_ in Taipei. He _(2)_take_ the MRT to school every day. The MRT station _(3)_is_ near his house.
questions.explanation: 「He」是第三人稱單數，一般動詞應加 -s，應為 takes。第 (1) 處 lives 和第 (3) 處 is 均正確，唯第 (2) 處 take 缺少第三人稱單數的 -s。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: be 動詞與一般動詞現在式
questions.stem:
【情境題】小美在社群媒體上發文描述她的寵物兔，請選出文法全部正確的選項。
"My rabbit _____(1)_____ very cute. It _____(2)_____ carrots and _____(3)_____ a lot every day."
questions.explanation: 「My rabbit / It」均為第三人稱單數：be 動詞用 is，一般動詞 like → likes，hop → hops（子音 + p + s）。三個動詞都需第三人稱單數形式。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: be 動詞與一般動詞現在式
questions.stem: 【易混淆辨析題】以下哪個句子正確表達「Jenny 和我都不是這個俱樂部的成員」？
options: Jenny and I don't members of the club.
Jenny and I are not members of the club.
Jenny and I isn't members of the club.
Jenny and I doesn't be members of the club.
questions.explanation: 「Jenny and I」等同於 We，是複數主詞，be 動詞用 are，否定形為 are not（aren't）。members 是名詞，需用 be 動詞而非 don't/doesn't。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】小明在介紹家人時說：「This is my sister. _____ name is Amy, and I love _____ very much.」請選出最適當的填入組合。
questions.explanation: sister 是女性，所有格用 Her（她的名字），受格用 her（我很愛她）。注意第二格是動詞 love 的受詞，需用受格 her，不可用主格 she。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【辨析題】下列句子中，哪一句的代名詞使用是「正確的」？
options: Me and Tom went to school together.
Tom and I went to school together.
Tom and me is best friends.
questions.explanation: 主詞位置須用主格。「Tom and I」是正確的主格形式。「Me and Tom」、「me」、「him」在主詞位置均屬錯誤用法。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】老師問學生：「Whose bag is this?」學生回答：「It's _____.」請選出正確的回答。
questions.explanation: Whose 問所有權，回答用獨立所有格（mine, yours, his, hers 等），不可說「It's my」（my 後面必須接名詞），因此答案是 mine（= my bag）。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【變化題】「The dog hurt _____ leg.」這句話中，空格應填入什麼？（the dog 是雄性）
questions.explanation: 動物通常使用 its（它的）作為所有格，而非 his/her，除非文章中有特別指定性別並以人格化方式描述。it's 是 it is 的縮寫，在此文法錯誤。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【應用題】請選出與「The book belongs to Linda.」意思最接近的句子。
questions.explanation: 表示「屬於某人」可用獨立所有格（hers）。「is hers」= belongs to her。選項 B「is her」文法錯誤；選項 D 為中式英文，不正確。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【易混淆題】「_____ are good friends, so people always invite _____ together.」請選出正確填入的一組代名詞。
questions.explanation: 第一格是主詞，用主格 They；第二格是 invite 的受詞，用受格 them。主格與受格需依句子結構正確選用。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】Amy 和 Betty 各有一本書。老師說：「This is Amy's book, and that is Betty's.」學生要用代名詞替換，下列哪句「正確且自然」？
options: This is her book, and that is her.
This is hers, and that is hers.
This is her, and that is hers.
This is hers book, and that is hers book.
questions.explanation: 當名詞已省略時，用獨立所有格 hers 來代替「Amy's book」和「Betty's book」。選項 D 中 hers 後面不可再接名詞，文法錯誤。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【辨析題】下列哪一句話使用了「反身代名詞」且用法正確？
options: She bought a gift for herself.
I met yourself at the park.
questions.explanation: herself 用於動作返回自身（買給自己），用法正確。反身代名詞不可當主詞（選項 B 錯）；yourself 不可替換受詞指另一人（選項 C 錯）；hisself 根本不是正確的英文字（應為 himself）。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【應用題】請問下列哪個句子中，「its」的用法是正確的？
options: The team its players are great.
questions.explanation: its（無撇號）是所有格，意為「它的」；it's（有撇號）= it is。選項 A 中 its tail 正確。選項 B 應為 It's（It is）。選項 C、D 均為錯誤用法。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【變化題】「My parents love my brother and _____.」句中空格應填入什麼以表示「也愛我」？
questions.explanation: love 是及物動詞，後面接受詞，因此用受格 me，而非主格 I。這是常見易錯點，許多人誤以為連接詞後需用主格。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】Tom 正在跟朋友介紹他的新手機：「Look at this phone. _____ screen is really big!」空格應填入什麼？
questions.explanation: 此處需要所有格來修飾名詞 screen，應用 its（它的螢幕）。it's = it is，放在此處意思不通；itself 是反身代名詞，也不適用。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【辨析題】老師說了四個句子，請選出「代名詞指代明確且正確」的句子。
options: When Mary met Lisa, she was happy.
John told his father that he was wrong.
Kevin and Ryan went out, and he came back late.
The students finished their homework on time.
questions.explanation: 選項 A、B、C 中代名詞指代對象模糊（she/he 不清楚指誰）。選項 D 中 their 明確指 the students（複數），代名詞指代清楚。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【應用題】「_____ is our new English teacher.」與「We all like _____ very much.」兩個空格中，應分別填入什麼？（指女老師）
questions.explanation: 第一句主詞位置用主格 She；第二句 like 的受詞位置用受格 her。主格與受格不可互換。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【易混淆題】下列哪一個句子中，所有格代名詞用法「正確」？
questions.explanation: 獨立所有格（mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs）本身不加撇號 's。yours、ours、hers 均無撇號，因此 your's、our's、her's 全部錯誤，只有 theirs 正確。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】小華說：「I did this project by _____.」想表達「我自己一個人完成這個專題」，空格應填入什麼？
questions.explanation: 「by oneself」是固定用法，意為「獨自、靠自己」。主詞是 I，對應反身代名詞為 myself。by me 不是此慣用語；by I 文法錯誤。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【應用題】Which sentence uses pronouns correctly to replace the underlined words? → "David gave the flowers to Sarah."
options: He gave the flowers to she.
questions.explanation: David 是主詞→ He（主格）；the flowers 是受詞→ them（受格）；to Sarah 是間接受詞→ to her（受格）。選項 A、C、D 均有受格/主格混用的錯誤。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【辨析題】「The twins dressed _____ in Halloween costumes.」空格應填入什麼反身代名詞？
questions.explanation: the twins 是複數第三人稱，對應反身代名詞為 themselves。himself/herself 用於單數；ourself 不是正確英文（複數應為 ourselves）。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【易混淆題】下列句子中，哪一句話中「your 和 you're」的使用是正確的？
options: Your going to love this movie.
You're my best friend, and your kindness is special.
questions.explanation: you're = you are（你是），your = 你的（所有格）。選項 D 中「You're my best friend」（你是我最好的朋友）和「your kindness」（你的善良）用法均正確。其餘選項混淆了兩者。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【綜合應用題】請閱讀下列對話，選出填入 (A)(B)(C) 最正確的一組：
Anna: Is this Kevin's bike?
Bob: No, (A)_____ bike is blue. This one must be (B)_____.
Anna: Oh, I think it's (C)_____ sister's.
questions.explanation: (A) 修飾名詞 bike，用所有格 His；(B) 作獨立所有格（= your bike），用 yours；(C) 修飾名詞 sister's，用所有格 your。選項 B 的 you're 是 you are 的縮寫，放此處意思錯誤。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】小明在日記中寫道：「I saw ___ elephant at the zoo yesterday. ___ elephant was very big.」請選出正確的冠詞填法。
questions.explanation: 第一次提到某個不特定的大象，用不定冠詞 an（elephant 以母音開頭）；第二次再次提及同一頭大象，改用定冠詞 the，表示雙方都知道是哪一頭。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【辨析題】下列哪一句英文文法正確？
options: I need some informations about this school.
She gave me a good advice yesterday.
We need three pieces of paper for this project.
There are many homeworks to finish tonight.
questions.explanation: paper（紙）是不可數名詞，計算時需用 piece(s) of，故 three pieces of paper 正確。information、advice、homework 均為不可數名詞，不可加 -s 或用 a。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【應用題】校刊記者正在採訪，她想說「我每天搭公車上學」，下列何者正確？
options: I go to school by a bus every day.
I go to school by the bus every day.
I go to school by bus every day.
I go to school by buses every day.
questions.explanation: 表示交通方式時，用「by + 交通工具（不加冠詞）」的固定句型，如 by bus、by train、by car，不能加 a 或 the。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】英語老師要求學生完成句子：「The teacher told us to read ___ book on the desk.」空格中應填入什麼？
questions.explanation: 「on the desk」是後位修飾語，限定了是哪一本特定的書，因此用定冠詞 the，表示雙方已知的特定事物。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【變化題】下列句子中，哪個名詞的複數形式拼寫有誤？
options: There are three knives on the table.
I see two deers in the forest.
The children are playing in the yard.
questions.explanation: deer 是不規則名詞，其單複數同形，不能加 -s，應寫成 deer（兩隻鹿也是 two deer）。knife → knives、tooth → teeth、child → children 均正確。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【易混淆題】Mary 說她「有點餓，想吃點東西」，哪個句子用法正確？
options: I want to eat a little foods.
I want to eat a few food.
I want to eat some food.
I want to eat many food.
questions.explanation: food 是不可數名詞，應用 some 修飾；a few 用於可數名詞，a little 用於不可數名詞但不加 -s，many 用於可數名詞複數，均不適合直接配 food 用於此句。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】老師在黑板上寫了填充題：「___ sun rises in the east.」正確答案是？
questions.explanation: 太陽、月亮等宇宙中獨一無二的天體，前面要加定冠詞 the，如 the sun、the moon、the earth，表示世界上只有一個的特定事物。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【應用題】Tom 要介紹他的職業，說「我的父親是醫生」，下列何者正確？
questions.explanation: 表示職業時，若非特指某位特定的醫生，應用不定冠詞 a/an（doctor 以子音開頭，用 a）；the doctor 暗示是特定某位醫生，不適合用來泛指職業。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【變化題】下列哪個選項的名詞變複數形式完全正確？
questions.explanation: mouse → mice（不規則），wolf → wolves（字尾 -f 改 -ves）均正確。roof → roofs（不是 rooves），ox → oxen（不規則，非 oxes），foot → feet（不是 foots）。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】課本裡有一題：「We should protect ___ environment.」正確的冠詞用法是？
questions.explanation: environment 在此指全人類共同面對、獨一無二的「環境」，屬於特定概念，須用定冠詞 the。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【易混淆題】下列句子哪一句正確表達「我有兩個好消息要告訴你」？
options: I have two good news to tell you.
I have two good newses to tell you.
I have two pieces of good news to tell you.
I have two good a news to tell you.
questions.explanation: news 是不可數名詞，不能直接用數字計數，需借助量詞 piece(s) of，故正確說法是 two pieces of good news。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【應用題】下列哪一句英文正確描述「彈鋼琴」這項活動？
options: She plays a piano every evening.
She plays the piano every evening.
She plays an piano every evening.
questions.explanation: 演奏樂器時，英文固定用「play the + 樂器名稱」，如 play the piano、play the guitar。這是慣用搭配，必須加定冠詞 the。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】作文課中，Anna 要描述「在一個雨天的下午」，她應該寫？
questions.explanation: rainy 以子音音素 /r/ 開頭，因此用不定冠詞 a，而非 an；此處泛指某個不特定的雨天下午，用 a 而非 the。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【辨析題】下列哪一個名詞屬於「集合名詞，通常不加 -s，也不搭配 a/an」的用法？
questions.explanation: furniture（傢俱）是不可數的集合名詞，不能說 a furniture 或 furnitures；若要表達數量，需說 a piece of furniture。book、idea、question 均為可數名詞。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【變化題】老師出了一題翻譯：「牆上有三幅畫。」下列何者正確？
options: There are three picture on the wall.
There are three pictures on the wall.
There is three pictures on the wall.
There is three picture on the wall.
questions.explanation: 三幅畫是複數，名詞需加 -s（pictures），there be 句型中，be 動詞應與後面名詞的數一致，複數名詞用 are，故選 There are three pictures。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【易混淆題】Which sentence uses articles correctly to describe a job application letter?
options: I am an university student looking for an job.
I am a university student looking for a job.
I am an university student looking for a job.
I am a university student looking for an job.
questions.explanation: university 雖以字母 u 開頭，但發音為 /juː/（子音音素），因此用 a 而非 an；job 以子音 /dʒ/ 開頭，也用 a。「a/an 的選擇取決於後接單字的發音，而非拼字」是常見易混淆點。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】健康課討論飲食，老師問：「Which sentence is correct about healthy habits?」
options: Eating a fruit every day is good for you.
Eating fruits every day is good for you.
Eating the fruit every day is good for you.
Eating fruit every day is good for you.
questions.explanation: 泛指「水果這類食物」時，fruit 作不可數名詞用，不加冠詞也不加 -s，直接說 eat fruit。若要說具體幾個，才說 a fruit 或 two fruits（此時為可數用法）。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【應用題】同學甲說：「Look at ___! It's so beautiful.」指著天空中剛升起的月亮，空格應填？
questions.explanation: 月亮是宇宙中獨一無二的天體，和 the sun、the earth 一樣，前面一律加定冠詞 the；指示某一特定、眾所周知的事物時也用 the。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【辨析題】下列關於「man」這個字的複數與冠詞用法，哪一句完全正確？
options: All mans need to sign in at the front desk.
An man called for you this morning.
Two men are waiting outside the office.
The mans in the photo are my brothers.
questions.explanation: man 的複數是不規則變化 men，不是 mans。an 用於母音開頭的單字，man 以子音 /m/ 開頭，應用 a。故只有 Two men are waiting 在名詞複數與動詞搭配上完全正確。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】小明正在跟媽媽說他現在的狀態。他說：「我現在正在做功課，所以不能幫你。」請選出正確的英文句子。
options: I do my homework now, so I can't help you.
I am doing my homework now, so I can't help you.
I doing my homework now, so I can't help you.
I was doing my homework now, so I can't help you.
questions.explanation: 現在進行式結構為「be動詞 + V-ing」，表示「現在正在進行」的動作。選項A用一般現在式，選項C缺少be動詞，選項D用過去進行式，皆不正確。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【辨析題】下列哪個句子使用了正確的現在進行式？
options: They are having a good time at the park.
He is wanting a new bike.
questions.explanation: know、want、need 為「狀態動詞」，通常不用進行式。have 當「經歷、享受」時可用進行式，「They are having a good time」是正確的用法。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【應用題】情境描述： Tom 和 Lisa 正在圖書館讀書，Tom 在看書，Lisa 在寫筆記。下列哪個描述「只描述 Lisa」且文法正確？
options: Tom and Lisa are reading books.
Lisa reads notes in the library.
questions.explanation: 只描述 Lisa 的動作「寫筆記」，用現在進行式應為「Lisa is taking notes.」選項A包含Tom，選項C用一般現在式，選項D結構錯誤（be動詞後不可直接接原形動詞）。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【否定句變化題】將「Kevin is playing basketball with his friends.」改為否定句，下列何者正確？
options: Kevin not is playing basketball with his friends.
Kevin is not playing basketball with his friends.
Kevin is playing not basketball with his friends.
Kevin does not playing basketball with his friends.
questions.explanation: 現在進行式的否定句，否定詞 not 須放在 be 動詞之後，即「be + not + V-ing」，所以正確答案為選項B。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【疑問句應用題】媽媽想問女兒「你在聽音樂嗎？」，下列何者正確？
questions.explanation: 現在進行式疑問句結構為「Be動詞 + 主詞 + V-ing?」，主詞 you 對應 are，動詞部分為 listening，故選項C正確。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【時間副詞辨析題】下列哪個時間副詞「最常」與現在進行式搭配使用？
questions.explanation: 現在進行式常與 now、right now、at the moment 等表示「此刻」的副詞搭配。yesterday 和 last week 用於過去式，every day 常用於一般現在式。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【對話情境題】A 問：「Where is your sister?」B 回答說妹妹正在廚房煮飯。下列哪個回答正確？
options: She is cook in the kitchen.
She is cooking in the kitchen.
She are cooking in the kitchen.
questions.explanation: 描述「正在進行」的動作用現在進行式，主詞 She 配合 is，動詞 cook 加 -ing，故「She is cooking in the kitchen.」正確。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【主詞一致性辨析題】下列哪個句子的主詞與 be 動詞搭配「正確」？
options: The dog are running in the yard.
My brother and I am doing homework.
The students are reading their books.
questions.explanation: 複數主詞 the students 應搭配 are。parents 為複數應用 are，the dog 為單數應用 is，my brother and I 為複數應用 are，故只有選項D正確。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【動詞變化辨析題】下列哪個動詞加上 -ing 的拼法「正確」？
questions.explanation: 以「短母音＋單子音」結尾的動詞，如 sit，需重複字尾再加 -ing，變成 sitting。swim → swimming，run → running，write → writing（去e加ing）。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【閱讀理解應用題】閱讀短文：「Look at the picture. A boy is sitting under a tree. He is reading a comic book and eating an apple. His dog is sleeping beside him.」根據短文，下列敘述何者「錯誤」？
options: The boy is sitting under a tree.
The boy is reading a comic book.
questions.explanation: 短文說男孩在吃蘋果（eating an apple），並非在喝果汁（drinking juice），故選項B的敘述錯誤。其餘選項與短文內容相符。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【易混淆辨析題】Mary usually _____ to school, but today she _____ because it's raining.
options: is walking / is taking a bus
questions.explanation: 第一格描述「習慣」用一般現在式 walks，第二格描述「今天正在進行」的特殊情況用現在進行式 is taking，故選項A正確。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境應用題】你打電話給朋友，對方說：「I can't talk right now. My family _____ dinner.」空格應填入：
questions.explanation: 主詞 My family 視為整體，為單數，搭配 is，且 right now 表示正在進行，故用現在進行式 is having。have dinner 表示「吃晚餐」，have 在此為動作動詞可用進行式。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【問答配對題】下列問句與回答的配對，哪一組「正確」？
options: Q: Is he sleeping? / A: Yes, he does.
Q: What are they doing? / A: They are playing soccer.
Q: Are you cooking? / A: Yes, I am cook.
Q: Is she reading? / A: No, she isn't reads.
questions.explanation: 現在進行式問句「What are they doing?」應回答「They are + V-ing」，選項B正確。選項A應回答 Yes, he is；選項C應回答 Yes, I am cooking；選項D應回答 No, she isn't reading。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【句子改寫題】將下列句子改為以「The children」為主詞的現在進行式：「jump rope in the playground」
options: The children jump rope in the playground.
The children is jumping rope in the playground.
The children are jumping rope in the playground.
The children be jumping rope in the playground.
questions.explanation: The children 為複數主詞，be 動詞用 are，動詞 jump 加 -ing 變 jumping，故「The children are jumping rope in the playground.」正確。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【語意辨析題】下列哪個句子的「現在進行式」用來表達「即將發生的計畫或安排」，而非「此刻正在進行」的動作？
options: She is sleeping on the sofa right now.
We are flying to Japan next Monday.
He is running in the park at the moment.
questions.explanation: 現在進行式有時可用來表示「確定的未來計畫」，選項C「We are flying to Japan next Monday.」中的 next Monday 表示這是一個未來安排。其他選項都是描述此刻正在發生的事。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【找錯誤題】下列句子中，哪一個句子「沒有文法錯誤」？
options: They isn't playing video games now.
Is the baby crying right now?
She are writing a letter to her friend.
My dad are fixing the car in the garage.
questions.explanation: 選項B「Is the baby crying right now?」主詞 the baby 為第三人稱單數，be 動詞用 is，問句結構正確。選項A應用 aren't，選項C應用 is，選項D應用 is。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境推理題】根據提示選出最合適的句子來描述圖片：圖片中，一位女孩戴著耳機，眼睛閉著，頭隨著音樂擺動。
options: The girl listens to music every day.
The girl is enjoying music right now.
The girl will listen to music later.
questions.explanation: 圖片描述的是「此刻正在發生」的事，應用現在進行式。The girl is enjoying music right now. 描述她正在享受音樂，符合圖片情境。enjoy 在表達「積極體驗」時可用進行式。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【多主詞辨析題】「Jason and his sister _____ TV, but their parents _____ in the garden.」最適合填入的組合是：
questions.explanation: Jason and his sister 為複數主詞，用 are watching；their parents 也是複數主詞，用 are working，故選項C正確。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境對話題】老師問班上同學：「Why aren't you paying attention?」，學生回答說他在想一個難題。下列哪個回答最正確？
options: Sorry, I am thinking about a difficult problem.
Sorry, I think about a difficult problem now.
Sorry, I am think about a difficult problem.
Sorry, I was thinking about a difficult problem.
questions.explanation: think 表「思考（動作）」時可用進行式，I am thinking about... 表示「我正在想……」，符合對話情境。選項B用一般現在式不符語境，選項C結構錯誤（be後接原形），選項D用過去進行式不符合當下情境。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【綜合辨析題】下列四個句子，哪一個「正確使用」了現在進行式且語意通順？
options: I am see a beautiful bird in the tree.
They are believing in hard work.
He is teaching his little sister how to ride a bike.
questions.explanation: see（看見）、believe（相信）、own（擁有）均為狀態動詞，通常不用進行式。teach 為動作動詞，「He is teaching his little sister how to ride a bike.」使用正確，語意也通順。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【情境題】小明問朋友昨天晚上做了什麼，請選出最正確的問句。
Which question is correct?
options: What did you do last night?
What did you last night do?
What do you did last night?
questions.explanation: wh- 疑問句結構為「疑問詞 + 助動詞 + 主詞 + 動詞原形」。did 為過去式助動詞，主動詞須用原形 do，因此選 (A)。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【辨析題】以下哪個回答與問句 "Where are your parents from?" 最對應？
questions.explanation: Where...from 問的是「來自哪裡／故鄉在哪」，應回答地點來源，選 (B)。(D) 雖然有地點但回答的是「現在在哪」，不符合 from 的語意。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【變化題】看對話，空格應填入哪個疑問詞？
A: _______ one is your bag, the red one or the blue one?
B: The blue one.
questions.explanation: 在有限選項（red or blue）中二選一，應使用 which（哪一個）。what 用於開放式問題，兩者易混淆，此題考辨析。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】媽媽問小孩：「你的生日是哪一天？」，下列何者正確？
questions.explanation: 問「時間點（日期）」通常用 when。(A) "What day" 問的是「星期幾」，語意略有不同；when 才能回答完整日期。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【易混淆辨析題】下列哪個問句的疑問詞使用「錯誤」？
questions.explanation: be 動詞句的主詞補語問句應用 who（主格），whom 用於受格（賓語）位置。"Whom is your best friend?" 中 whom 作主詞補語，應改為 Who is your best friend?，故 (C) 錯誤。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】你想問朋友「那隻狗是誰的？」，應該說：
questions.explanation: whose 可當形容詞修飾名詞，正確語序為 Whose + 名詞 + be + 主詞，即 Whose dog is that?。(C) 為最自然且符合文法的選項。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【變化題】看以下對話，空格應填入哪個選項？
A: _______ does it take to go to the station?
B: About twenty minutes.
questions.explanation: 回答「大約二十分鐘」是時間長度，應用 How long（多久）。How far 問距離，How often 問頻率，How many 問數量，均不符。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【應用題】下列句子中，疑問詞作「主詞」用的是哪一個？
options: What did you eat for lunch?
questions.explanation: Who broke the window? 中，who 直接作句子主詞，後面直接接動詞（broke），不須倒裝，是 wh- 疑問詞當主詞的典型例子。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】店員想問顧客「您需要幾個？」，應該說：
questions.explanation: 問「可數名詞的數量」用 How many。How much 用於不可數名詞或問價格，此處語境為可數物品數量，選 (B)。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【辨析題】下列哪個問句用來問「搭什麼交通工具」最為正確？
options: How do you go to school?
What do you go to school?
Where do you go to school by?
Why do you go to school?
questions.explanation: 問交通方式用 How（如何前往），回答為 by bus / on foot 等。(B) 用 what 搭配 go to school 語意不完整，(C) 結構錯誤，(D) 問原因不符。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【變化題】看對話，空格填入何者最合適？
A: _______ is your English teacher like?
B: She is strict but funny.
questions.explanation: "What is...like?" 是固定問法，意思是「...的個性／特質如何？」。How 雖也問狀態，但 How is she? 通常問身體狀況。What...like 是描述人物特質的固定句型。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【易混淆辨析題】下列哪一句話詢問的是「價格」？
questions.explanation: 詢問價格的固定問法是 How much is...?，因為錢（money）是不可數名詞。How many 用於可數名詞，此題考 how much / how many 的辨析。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【應用題】以下哪個問句的回答可以是 "Twice a week"？
questions.explanation: "Twice a week"（每週兩次）表示頻率，對應問句為 How often（多常／頻率為何）。How long 問時間長度，How far 問距離，均不符。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【變化題】以下對話空格應填入哪個選項？
A: _______ did you feel when you heard the news?
B: I felt very surprised.
questions.explanation: 問「感受／心情如何」用 How（How did you feel...?）。What 問的是「什麼事物」，此處回答 felt surprised 是狀態描述，應用 How。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【辨析題】下列句子何者為「間接問句」且文法正確？
options: Can you tell me where does she live?
Can you tell me where she lives?
Can you tell me where she does live?
Can you tell me where is she live?
questions.explanation: 間接問句（名詞子句）不用倒裝，語序應為「疑問詞 + 主詞 + 動詞」，因此 where she lives 正確。(A)(C)(D) 均保留了直接問句的倒裝或多餘助動詞，屬常見錯誤。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】警察問目擊者「事故是何時發生的？」，下列哪個問句正確？
options: What time did the accident happen?
When time did the accident happen?
questions.explanation: 問「幾點（具體時刻）」用 What time，問「時間（廣義）」可用 When。(B) When time 為錯誤組合，(C)(D) 用法明顯錯誤，選 (A)。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【應用題】下列哪個問句可以引導出 "Because I was tired." 這個答案？
options: What did you go to bed early?
When did you go to bed early?
Why did you go to bed early?
How did you go to bed early?
questions.explanation: Because 開頭的答句是在解釋「原因」，因此對應的疑問詞應為 Why（為什麼）。這是 why 問句與 because 回答的固定搭配。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【易混淆辨析題】下列哪個問句中，疑問詞的使用與其他三個「不同類」？
options: How does she go to work?
questions.explanation: (A)(B)(D) 中的 How 後面接形容詞（tall/old/heavy），是「How + 形容詞」的程度問法。(C) 的 How 後面接動詞，問的是「方式」，與其他三題的用法不同類，因此選 (C)。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【情境題】Mary 今天跟朋友說她昨天的行程。請選出正確的句子。
Mary said, "I _____ to the library after school yesterday, but my friend _____ not come with me."
questions.explanation: 描述昨天的事要用過去式。go 的過去式是 went（不規則變化）；否定句用 did not（縮寫 didn't），助動詞 did 後面動詞用原形，故選 went / did。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【辨析題】下列哪個句子的時態使用是「正確的」？
options: She buyed a new dress last weekend.
They taked the bus to school this morning.
He wrote a letter to his pen pal two days ago.
We are saw a movie last night.
questions.explanation: write 的過去式是 wrote（不規則）。buy → bought、take → took，故 A、B 錯誤；D 句 are saw 結構完全錯誤。只有 C 正確。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【克漏字】Kevin _____ his homework, _____ dinner, and _____ to bed early last night.
(依序填入空格)
questions.explanation: 三個動作都發生在 last night，全部用過去式：finish → finished（規則）、have → had（不規則）、go → went（不規則）。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【否定句改寫】原句："Tom saw his old teacher at the park yesterday."
改成否定句應為：
options: Tom didn't saw his old teacher at the park yesterday.
Tom didn't see his old teacher at the park yesterday.
Tom doesn't saw his old teacher at the park yesterday.
Tom doesn't see his old teacher at the park yesterday.
questions.explanation: 過去式否定句結構為 did not + 動詞原形，不能用過去式。現在式助動詞 doesn't 不適用於過去時間，故選 didn't see。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【疑問句】下列哪個疑問句文法正確且符合過去式用法？
options: Did she went to the concert last Saturday?
Did they enjoyed the party last night?
Did he find his lost wallet this morning?
Does she called her mom yesterday?
questions.explanation: Did + 主詞 + 動詞原形。find 的原形即為 find（過去式是 found，但疑問句中 did 之後要用原形 find）。A、B 用了過去式，D 時態助動詞錯誤。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【情境應用】閱讀以下短文，選出錯誤的句子。
(A) Lisa woke up late this morning.
(B) She missed the school bus.
(C) Her dad drived her to school.
(D) She arrived just before class started.
questions.explanation: drive 的過去式是 drove（不規則變化），drived 是錯誤的寫法。其他句子：wake → woke、miss → missed（規則）、arrive → arrived（規則）均正確。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【選詞填空】The concert _____ at 7:00 p.m. and _____ at 9:30 p.m. last Friday. Everyone _____ a great time.
questions.explanation: last Friday 表示過去，三個動詞均用過去式：begin → began（不規則）、end → ended（規則）、have → had（不規則）。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【易混淆辨析】Which sentence uses the past tense CORRECTLY?
（哪個句子過去式用法正確？）
options: I have visit my grandparents last summer.
We were play basketball after school yesterday.
She didn't brought her umbrella, so she got wet.
The students sat quietly during the exam.
questions.explanation: sit 的過去式是 sat（不規則），第 D 句正確。A 句應用 visited；B 句 were play 結構錯誤，應用 played；C 句 didn't 後應接原形 bring，不是 brought。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【圖表情境】Andy 的週末記錄如下：Saturday: ride a bike / Sunday: make cookies
請選出正確描述安迪週末的句子。
options: Andy rode a bike on Saturday and maked cookies on Sunday.
Andy ride a bike on Saturday and made cookies on Sunday.
Andy rode a bike on Saturday and made cookies on Sunday.
Andy rided a bike on Saturday and made cookies on Sunday.
questions.explanation: ride 的過去式是 rode（不規則）；make 的過去式是 made（不規則）。rided 和 maked 均為錯誤拼法。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【對話題】A: _____ you _____ your homework before dinner last night?
B: No, I _____ it after dinner.
（選出最適合填入的選項）
questions.explanation: 疑問句：Did you finish...? → Did + 主詞 + 動詞原形。回答否定後說明事實：I finished it after dinner（過去式肯定句）。故選 Did / finish / finished。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【改錯題】找出下列句子中有文法錯誤的部分。
"Last month, my family (A)traveled to Tainan, and we (B)eated the famous beef soup. My little sister (C)said it was the best soup (D)she had ever tried."
questions.explanation: eat 的過去式是 ate（不規則變化），eated 是錯誤拼法。其他部分：travel → traveled（規則）、say → said（不規則）均正確；D 為過去完成式，語法合理。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【長對話理解】
Mom: Where did you go after school today?
Son: I _____ to the bookstore with Jason. We _____ two comic books together.
（選出正確填入的動詞過去式）
questions.explanation: go 的過去式是 went；buy 的過去式是 bought（不規則）。buyed 是常見的錯誤拼法，正確答案為 went / bought。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【比較辨析】下列四句中，哪一句的過去式動詞「規則變化」（加 -ed）是正確且完整拼寫的？
options: He hopeed to win the game.
They planned a surprise party for Tim.
We traveld to Japan last year.
questions.explanation: plan 的結尾是「子音+母音+子音」，需雙寫字尾再加 -ed，故 planned 正確。stop → stopped（不是 stoped）；hope → hoped（非 hopeed）；travel → traveled（非 traveld）。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境完成句子】The fire drill _____ while the students _____ lunch in the cafeteria yesterday.
questions.explanation: happen 是不及物動詞，用主動過去式 happened；背景動作「正在吃午餐」用過去進行式 were having，表示當時持續進行的動作。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【多重否定辨析】Jenny _____ go to school last Monday because she _____ sick.
（選出正確填入的選項）
questions.explanation: last Monday 是過去時間，否定用 didn't + 動詞原形（go）；主詞 Jenny 是第三人稱單數，be 動詞過去式用 was，故選 didn't / was。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【補充說明題】下列哪個句子最能正確說明「Ben 昨天沒有帶午餐去學校，所以在福利社買了東西吃」？
options: Ben doesn't bring his lunch to school yesterday, so he buys food at the school store.
Ben didn't bring his lunch to school yesterday, so he bought food at the school store.
Ben didn't brought his lunch to school yesterday, so he buyed food at the school store.
Ben not bring his lunch to school yesterday, so he bought food at the school store.
questions.explanation: 過去式否定：didn't + 動詞原形（bring）；買東西：buy 的過去式是 bought。C 句 didn't 後面不能接過去式 brought；D 句否定結構錯誤。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【口語應用】A: How was your trip to Kenting?
B: It was amazing! We _____ in the ocean, _____ great seafood, and _____ a beautiful sunset.
（swim / eat / see，請選出全部正確的過去式形式）
questions.explanation: swim → swam（不規則）；eat → ate（不規則）；see → saw（不規則）。swimmed、eated、seed 均為錯誤的過去式拼法。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【排列組合】以下片語依序為：主詞＋動詞＋其餘
(1) last night / I / fall asleep / on the sofa
請選出排列正確且時態正確的句子。
options: I falled asleep on the sofa last night.
I fell asleep on the sofa last night.
I fall asleep on the sofa last night.
I have fell asleep on the sofa last night.
questions.explanation: fall 的過去式是 fell（不規則變化），falled 是錯誤拼法。last night 明確指出過去時間，不需用完成式，故選 fell。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【情境推理題】請根據文章選出描述正確的過去式句子。
"Eric's alarm didn't ring this morning. He woke up at 8:30, so he had only ten minutes to get ready."
Which sentence best describes what probably happened?
options: Eric took his time getting ready and arrived at school on time.
Eric rushed to get ready and might have been late for school.
Eric decided to stay home because he woke up late.
Eric woke up early and had a big breakfast before school.
questions.explanation: 文中說 Eric 8:30 才醒，只有十分鐘準備，合理推斷他應該急忙準備、可能遲到（rushed / might have been late）。A、C、D 均與文意不符。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【綜合辨析】下列哪一組動詞的「過去式變化類型」配對是正確的？
questions.explanation: stop → stopped 是規則變化（字尾重複子音加 -ed）；take → took 是不規則變化，兩者均正確。cut 的過去式是 cut（原形不變）；play → played（非 plaied）。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: 未來式 will 與 be going to
questions.stem:
【情境應用】小明問朋友今晚的計畫，朋友回答說他們已經決定要去看電影。請選出最符合情境的句子。
Which sentence best shows a pre-arranged plan for tonight?
options: We will go to the movies tonight.
We are going to go to the movies tonight.
We go to the movies tonight.
We would go to the movies tonight.
questions.explanation: be going to 用於表示事先已計畫好的事情（pre-arranged plan），此處朋友已決定好計畫，應用 are going to。will 則多用於當下臨時決定或預測。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: 未來式 will 與 be going to
questions.stem:
【辨析題】媽媽看到桌上的玻璃杯快要掉下去，她驚呼道：「小心！那個杯子……」請選出最自然的說法。
Mom sees the glass on the edge of the table and says, 'Watch out! The glass _____ fall!'
questions.explanation: be going to 可用於根據眼前證據（evidence）判斷即將發生的事，杯子快要掉是明顯的眼前跡象，故用 is going to。will 較不適合用於「眼前徵兆」的預測。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: 未來式 will 與 be going to
questions.stem:
【情境題】電話響了，小雨正忙著做菜，她對家人說：「我雙手都是麵團，你能幫我接電話嗎？」家人回答：「好，我去接。」家人的回應應用哪種未來式？
Family member responds: '_____ get it!' (a spontaneous decision)
questions.explanation: will 用於當下臨時、自發性的決定（spontaneous decision），此處家人是剛聽到請求後馬上決定要去接電話，應用 I will。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: 未來式 will 與 be going to
questions.stem:
【變化題】下列句子中，哪一句的未來式用法「不正確」？
Which sentence uses the future tense INCORRECTLY?
options: Look at those dark clouds. It is going to rain.
I think she will pass the exam.
We are going to having a party next Friday.
He will probably be late for school.
questions.explanation: 選項C文法錯誤：be going to 後面應接動詞原形，不能用 having，正確應為 are going to have。其他選項文法皆正確。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: 未來式 will 與 be going to
questions.stem:
【應用題】老師問全班：「誰願意幫我擦黑板？」小玉主動舉手。小玉說的話應該是哪一句？
Teacher asks who will clean the board. Xiao-Yu volunteers and says:
options: I am going to clean it. I planned it last night.
I'm going to clean it because I scheduled it.
questions.explanation: 自發性、當下做的決定用 will，此處小玉是聽到老師說話後才臨時決定，故用 I will clean it 最自然。選項A和D暗示事先計畫，與情境不符。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: 未來式 will 與 be going to
questions.stem:
【易混淆辨析題】下列哪個句子中的 will 和 be going to 可以「互換使用」而意思幾乎不變？
In which sentence can 'will' and 'be going to' be used interchangeably with little change in meaning?
options: Watch out! You are going to fall!
I will answer the phone. (said right after it rings)
Scientists predict that temperatures will rise in the future.
She is going to visit her grandmother this weekend. (already planned)
questions.explanation: 對於未來的「一般預測」（general prediction），will 和 be going to 常可互換；選項C描述科學預測，兩者皆可用且意思相近。選項A強調眼前跡象、B是臨時決定、D是事先計畫，各有各的偏好用法。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: 未來式 will 與 be going to
questions.stem:
【情境題】大偉和朋友規劃了一個月的暑假旅遊，出發前一天朋友問他：「你們明天去哪？」大偉的回答最適合用哪種句型？
Dawei's trip has been planned for a month. His friend asks where they're going tomorrow. Dawei should say:
options: We will fly to Japan tomorrow.
We are flying to Japan tomorrow.
We are going to fly to Japan tomorrow.
Both B and C are correct.
questions.explanation: 事先安排好的計畫可以用 be going to 或現在進行式（present continuous）表達確定的未來計畫，兩者皆正確自然。故答案為 Both B and C are correct（選項索引3）。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: 未來式 will 與 be going to
questions.stem:
【變化題】以下對話中，空格最適合填入哪個選項？
A: 'The laptop is broken again!'
B: 'Don't worry. My brother _____ fix it. He's a computer engineer and already agreed to help.'
questions.explanation: 哥哥「已經答應」要來修，是事先安排好的計畫，應用 be going to。若是當下B突然決定去找哥哥，才用 will。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: 未來式 will 與 be going to
questions.stem:
【辨析題】下列哪一句「最適合」用在正式書面預測（例如科學報告）中？
Which sentence is most appropriate for a formal written prediction in a science report?
options: Global temperatures are going to get higher and higher.
Global temperatures will continue to rise over the next century.
Global temperatures are getting higher and higher right now.
Global temperatures got higher in the past.
questions.explanation: 正式預測或報告中習慣用 will 表達對未來的推斷，語氣較客觀中立。be going to 較口語，多用於有具體跡象或個人計畫的情況。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: 未來式 will 與 be going to
questions.stem:
【情境應用題】媽媽看到小孩沒帶傘就要出門，外面烏雲密布，她說：「你最好帶傘，因為……」請選出最符合情境的說法。
Mom says: 'You'd better take an umbrella because it _____ rain.'
questions.explanation: 烏雲密布是眼前可見的跡象（evidence），依據跡象預測即將發生的事應用 be going to。will 也可接受，但 be going to 更精準強調「有根據的預測」。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: 未來式 will 與 be going to
questions.stem:
【變化題】選出文法正確且意思完整的句子。
Choose the grammatically correct and meaningful sentence.
options: She will to call you later.
They are going to leaves early tomorrow.
He is going to study harder from now on.
We will going to the store after school.
questions.explanation: 選項C正確：be going to + 動詞原形（study）。選項A錯誤（will 後不加 to）；選項B錯誤（going to 後應用原形 leave，不是 leaves）；選項D錯誤（will 後不加 going to）。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: 未來式 will 與 be going to
questions.stem:
【情境題】Alex 問 Bella 下午的計畫，Bella 說她打算去圖書館還書（這是昨天就決定好的）。請選出正確句子。
Bella says her plan (decided yesterday): 'I _____ return the books to the library this afternoon.'
questions.explanation: 昨天已決定好的計畫（pre-made plan）應用 be going to，此處 I am going to return 最符合情境。will 用於臨時決定或一般預測，在此較不自然。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: 未來式 will 與 be going to
questions.stem:
【應用題】Tom 和 Jerry 談到未來夢想，Tom 說他「想要」成為一名醫生，用哪個說法表達他的「期望」最自然？
Tom expresses his future wish/hope: 'I _____ be a doctor someday.'
questions.explanation: 表達對未來的希望、期望（hope/wish）通常用 will，語氣較輕、不確定。be going to 暗示已有具體計畫或準備，用在此處語氣過於確定，較不自然。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: 未來式 will 與 be going to
questions.stem:
【易混淆辨析題】下列哪個句子中，will 的使用「語氣最強烈」，帶有承諾（promise）的意味？
In which sentence does 'will' carry the strongest sense of a promise?
options: I think it will snow tomorrow.
She will probably forget her keys again.
I will never lie to you again, I promise.
The train will arrive at 8 a.m.
questions.explanation: will 除了預測，也可用來表達「承諾」（promise）。選項C明確說出 'I promise'，是 will 作為承諾用法最典型的例子。其他選項都是預測或時刻表說明。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: 未來式 will 與 be going to
questions.stem:
【情境題】小明剛打破了花瓶，媽媽氣得說：「你等著，你爸回來……」（暗示威脅、預測後果）。以下哪句最符合這個語氣？
Mom warns: 'Just wait until your father gets home. He _____ be very angry!'
questions.explanation: 這是說話者當下做出的預測或警告，並非事先計畫，用 will 最自然。be going to 也可接受，但 will 在威脅語氣中更常見。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: 未來式 will 與 be going to
questions.stem:
【變化題】請選出對話中空格最合適的答案。
A: 'Are you free this Saturday?'
B: 'Sorry, I can't. I _____ attend my cousin's wedding. We booked the venue months ago.'
questions.explanation: 婚禮「幾個月前就訂好場地」，是確定的事先安排，應用 be going to（am going to）。will 較適合臨時決定，was going to 表示「原本打算但後來沒做」，都不符合此情境。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: 未來式 will 與 be going to
questions.stem:
【辨析題】以下哪一句使用了「時刻表未來式」（scheduled future with present simple），而「不是」用 will 或 be going to？
Which sentence expresses a future event using a timetable / schedule (present simple), NOT will or be going to?
options: The bus will leave at 9 o'clock.
The bus is going to leave at 9 o'clock.
The bus leaves at 9 o'clock tomorrow.
The bus is leaving at 9 o'clock.
questions.explanation: 時刻表、班表等固定行程可用現在簡單式表達未來（present simple for scheduled events）。選項C 'The bus leaves at 9 o'clock tomorrow' 就是這種用法，選項A用 will，選項B用 be going to，選項D用現在進行式。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: 未來式 will 與 be going to
questions.stem:
【應用題】根據句意，選出正確的未來式形式。
'By the time you read this letter, I _____ already left for Canada.'
questions.explanation: 此句型 'By the time...I will have + 過去分詞' 是未來完成式（future perfect），表達在某個未來時間點之前已完成的動作。will have left 是正確形式。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: 未來式 will 與 be going to
questions.stem:
【情境應用題】以下選項中，哪一句最適合用來表示「為未來做好了準備/跡象明顯」？
Which sentence best shows that there is clear evidence or preparation for a future event?
options: I think I will get a good grade.
I am going to get a good grade — I've studied every day for a month!
I will probably pass the test.
I might pass the test if I study.
questions.explanation: be going to 強調有具體根據或跡象支持的預測，選項B說「我每天念了一個月的書」，是有根據的自信預測，be going to 最恰當。其他選項帶有「不確定、猜測」的語氣，適合用 will、probably、might。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: 未來式 will 與 be going to
questions.stem:
【綜合辨析題】下列哪一組句子，will 和 be going to 的語意差異「最明顯」？
In which pair is the difference in meaning between 'will' and 'be going to' MOST clear?
options: A: 'I will have coffee.' / B: 'I am going to have coffee.' (ordering at a café)
A: 'She will be 16 next year.' / B: 'She is going to be 16 next year.'
A: 'I will help you move.' (just decided now) / B: 'I am going to help you move.' (I already promised last week)
A: 'It will rain tomorrow.' / B: 'It is going to rain tomorrow.' (same weather report)
questions.explanation: 選項C最能呈現兩者差異：will 表示當下臨時決定（就在這一刻決定要幫忙），be going to 表示事先已承諾計畫好的事。這是 will 與 be going to 最核心的語意區別。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【情境題】Amy 想向朋友介紹她的三隻貓。她說：「Mimi 是三隻裡面最懶的。」請選出正確的英文句子。
Amy wants to say that Mimi is the laziest of her three cats. Which sentence is correct?
options: Mimi is lazier than the other two cats.
Mimi is the most lazy of the three cats.
Mimi is the laziest of the three cats.
Mimi is more lazier than the others.
questions.explanation: 三個以上用最高級，「lazy」為雙音節字但符合 -y 結尾規則，最高級為 the laziest。選項(B) the most lazy 雖意思接近，但 lazy 應用 -iest，不用 most；選項(D) more lazier 是雙重比較級，為文法錯誤。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【辨析題】下列哪一句的比較級用法「正確」？
options: This bag is more heavier than that one.
She runs more faster than her sister.
The new phone is more expensive than the old one.
Today is more hot than yesterday.
questions.explanation: expensive 為多音節形容詞，比較級須用 more，故 more expensive 正確。heavy、fast、hot 皆為單音節或特殊規則字，比較級應分別用 heavier、faster、hotter，不可加 more。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【應用題】Kevin 說：「我越來越忙了。」請選出最符合此意思的英文句子。
options: Kevin is getting busier and busier.
Kevin becomes more and more busy.
Kevin is the busiest he ever was.
questions.explanation: 「越來越……」的句型用「比較級 + and + 比較級」，busy 的比較級是 busier，所以正確句為 busier and busier。選項(C) more and more busy 在此不符合 -y 結尾的變化規則，應用 busier and busier。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】老師在黑板上寫下："The _______ you study, the _______ your grades will be." 請選出填入空格後語意與文法皆正確的選項。
questions.explanation: 「The + 比較級…, the + 比較級…」句型表示「越…越…」。hard 的比較級是 harder，good 的比較級是 better（不規則變化），故答案為 harder / better。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【變化題】Which sentence uses the superlative form INCORRECTLY?
options: Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world.
This is the most delicious cake I have ever eaten.
She is the most tallest girl in our class.
That was the worst movie I have seen this year.
questions.explanation: tall 為單音節形容詞，最高級應用 tallest，不可同時加 most，故 most tallest 是錯誤的雙重最高級（double superlative）。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【易混淆辨析題】下列哪一句中的 than 使用正確且句子語意合理？
options: My score is more higher than yours.
He arrived earlier than I expected.
This book is the better than that one.
She is more smarter than her brother.
questions.explanation: early 的比較級是 earlier，搭配 than 使用完全正確，句意「他比我預期的還早到」合理。選項(A)和(D)皆為雙重比較級；選項(C)的 the better 不應搭配 than 使用。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【情境題】Emma 正在比較兩家餐廳。她說餐廳 A 的服務比餐廳 B 好，但餐廳 B 的食物比餐廳 A 便宜。Which sentence BEST expresses this idea?
(Emma compares two restaurants: Restaurant A has better service, Restaurant B has cheaper food.)
options: Restaurant A has the best service, and Restaurant B has the cheapest food.
Restaurant A's service is better than Restaurant B's, but Restaurant B's food is cheaper than Restaurant A's.
Restaurant A serves better than Restaurant B, but Restaurant B is more cheap than Restaurant A.
Restaurant A is better service than Restaurant B, and Restaurant B food is cheaper.
questions.explanation: 正確使用所有格與比較級：A's service is better than B's，B's food is cheaper than A's，結構對稱且文法正確。選項(C) more cheap 錯誤（應用 cheaper）；選項(A)誤用最高級。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【應用題】Peter's height: 165 cm. Tom's height: 165 cm. Lisa's height: 172 cm.
Which sentence is TRUE?
options: Lisa is the tallest of the three.
Peter is as tall as Lisa.
questions.explanation: Lisa 的身高最高（172 cm），所以 Lisa is the tallest of the three 正確。Peter 和 Tom 一樣高，選項(A)(C)錯誤；選項(D) Peter as tall as Lisa 也錯誤，因為 Peter 165 ≠ Lisa 172。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【變化題】"No other student in the class is as smart as Jenny." 這句話的意思與下列哪一句「最接近」？
options: Jenny is smarter than some students in the class.
Jenny is the smartest student in the class.
Some students are smarter than Jenny.
Jenny is smart, but not the smartest.
questions.explanation: 「No other + 單數名詞 + is as ... as + 主語」等同於最高級的表達，意思是「Jenny 是全班最聰明的」。這是比較級與最高級互換的重要考點。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【辨析題】下列關於 good / better / best 和 bad / worse / worst 的句子，哪一句「正確」？
options: My English is more good than my Math.
This is the most bad day of my life.
Her cooking is better than her sister's.
Today's weather is more worse than yesterday's.
questions.explanation: good 的比較級是 better（不規則），用 her cooking is better than her sister's 完全正確。good 不可用 more good；bad 的最高級是 worst，不可說 most bad；worse 不可再加 more。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】廣告文案寫道：「我們的產品比市面上任何其他產品都還要耐用。」Which sentence BEST expresses this advertising claim?
options: Our product is the most durable of any other product on the market.
Our product is more durable than any other product on the market.
Our product is as durable as any other product on the market.
Our product is durable more than other products on the market.
questions.explanation: 「比市面上任何其他產品都還要……」用「比較級 + than any other + 單數名詞」來表達，等同最高級的語意。選項(A)語意邏輯矛盾（最高級不需再比較 any other）；選項(C)只表示一樣耐用。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【應用題】請根據語意選出正確句子：小明跑步的速度是全校「第二快」的。
options: Ming runs the second fastest in the school.
Ming runs second more fast in the school.
Ming is the second most fast runner in the school.
Ming runs faster than the fastest in the school.
questions.explanation: 「第二……」用「the second + 最高級」，fast 的最高級是 fastest，所以是 the second fastest。選項(C) most fast 錯誤，應用 fastest；選項(D)語意矛盾。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【易混淆辨析題】下列哪一句使用 as...as 句型「正確」？
options: This box is as heavier as that one.
She doesn't sing as beautiful as her mother.
The test was not as difficult as I thought.
He is as more careful as his father.
questions.explanation: as...as 句型中間須填形容詞或副詞的「原級」。The test was not as difficult as I thought 正確使用原級 difficult。選項(A)用比較級 heavier 錯誤；選項(B)應用副詞 beautifully；選項(D) more careful 也錯誤。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】小華在日記裡寫道：「今天是我這學期最充實的一天。」Which sentence correctly expresses this?
options: Today is the most fulfilling day of this semester.
Today is more fulfilling day than this semester.
Today is the fulfillest day in this semester.
Today was more fulfilling than the most days of this semester.
questions.explanation: fulfilling 為多音節形容詞，最高級用 the most fulfilling，表示「這學期最充實的一天」。選項(C)錯誤地用 -est 在多音節字上；選項(D)語意與原意不符。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【變化題】下列四個句子中，哪一句表達「越接近考試，同學們越緊張」最正確？
options: The closer the exam is, the more nervous the students get.
The more close the exam is, the nervousness students get.
The closest the exam is, the most nervous the students get.
Closer exam makes students more nervous and nervous.
questions.explanation: 「The + 比較級…, the + 比較級…」表示「越…越…」。close 比較級 closer、nervous 比較級 more nervous，句型結構完整正確。選項(C)誤用最高級；選項(D)結構不正確。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【辨析題】Which sentence correctly compares using a noun (名詞比較)?
options: She has more patience than her brother does.
She has more patient than her brother does.
She is more patience than her brother.
She has the most patience as her brother.
questions.explanation: patience 是不可數名詞，比較時用 more patience than。選項(B) more patient 把形容詞當名詞用；選項(C)用 is 接名詞語意怪異；選項(D)最高級不搭配 as。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【應用題】閱讀下列訊息後選出正確句子：
Dan: I got 85 on the math test.
Sue: I got 90.
Lily: I got 78.
Which sentence is TRUE?
options: Dan did better than Sue on the math test.
Lily did the worst of the three on the math test.
Sue did worse than Dan on the math test.
Dan got the highest score of the three.
questions.explanation: Lily 得了78分，是三人中最低的，所以 Lily did the worst of the three 正確。Sue 90分最高，Dan 85分居中，其餘選項皆與數據不符。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【易混淆辨析題】下列關於「far」比較級的句子，哪一句「正確」？
options: The park is more far from here than the school.
Your house is farther from school than mine is.
The hospital is farest place in this city.
She lives far more than I do from the city.
questions.explanation: far 的比較級是 farther（指距離）或 further（指程度），最高級是 farthest/furthest。選項(B) farther...than 用法完全正確。選項(A) more far 錯誤；選項(C) farest 拼寫錯誤（應為 farthest）。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】學校運動會後，老師說：「越多學生參加，運動會就辦得越成功。」將這句話改寫成英文，哪個選項最正確？
options: More students join, more successful the sports day will be.
The most students join, the most successful the sports day is.
The more students join, the more successful the sports day will be.
The more students join, the most successful the sports day will be.
questions.explanation: 「The + 比較級…, the + 比較級…」句型中，兩個子句都必須用比較級。many 的比較級是 more，successful 的比較級是 more successful，全句為 The more...the more...，選項(C)完全正確。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【情境題】小明感冒發燒，媽媽說他今天不能去上學。請選出最符合語意的句子。

Ming has a fever today. His mother says he _____ go to school.
questions.explanation: cannot 表示「不能／不可以」，符合「不能去上學」的語意。must 是「必須」，should 是「應該」，can 是「可以」，皆與語意不符。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【辨析題】下列句子中，哪一句的 must 表達的是「推測」而非「義務」？
options: You must finish your homework before dinner.
She must be tired after running for two hours.
Students must wear uniforms at school.
questions.explanation: She must be tired 的 must 用於邏輯推測，意思是「她一定很累」。其他三句的 must 皆表示規定或義務。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【應用題】老師告訴同學，考試時不可以作弊，且一定要帶鉛筆。請選出同時表達這兩個規定的正確組合。

During the test, you _____ cheat, and you _____ bring a pencil.
questions.explanation: must not 表示「禁止（不可以）」，must 表示「必須」，兩者合用最符合老師的強制規定語氣。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【變化題】下列哪個句子在語意上與 "You should apologize to her." 最接近？
options: You must apologize to her right now.
It is a good idea for you to apologize to her.
You are not allowed to apologize to her.
You can apologize to her if you want.
questions.explanation: should 表示「建議、應該」，"It is a good idea for you to..." 是其常見改寫方式，意思最為接近。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】圖書館門口貼著告示：「館內禁止飲食。」請選出最符合告示內容的英文句子。
options: You should eat or drink in the library.
You must eat or drink in the library.
You must not eat or drink in the library.
You can eat or drink in the library.
questions.explanation: must not 表示強制禁止，用於公共場所告示最為正式且語氣最強，符合「禁止飲食」的規定。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【易混淆辨析題】Amy 想去參加派對，但她還沒寫完功課。她的爸爸說：「妳把功課寫完才可以去。」請選出最符合爸爸話語的句子。

Amy's father says, "You _____ go to the party after you finish your homework."
questions.explanation: can 在此表示「被允許可以」，即「完成功課後才被允許去」。must 是「必須去」，語意不符；should 只是建議，力道不足。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】Kevin 練習籃球已經練了三年，現在投籃命中率很高。下列哪個句子最能描述這個情況？
options: Kevin must play basketball very well.
Kevin can shoot the ball very well now.
Kevin should shoot the ball very well.
Kevin must not miss the ball.
questions.explanation: can 表示透過練習而具備的「能力」，"can shoot the ball very well" 最能表達 Kevin 現在的籃球技能。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【辨析題】下列句子中，哪一句表示「給予建議」，而不是「表達能力」或「規定義務」？
options: You must hand in the report by Friday.
You should drink more water every day.
We cannot enter the room without permission.
questions.explanation: should 在此表示「建議」，喝更多水是對健康的建議。其他句子分別表示能力(can)、義務(must)、禁止(cannot)。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【應用題】公告中寫著：「參加者必須年滿 12 歲。」請選出最符合公告語意的英文句子。

The notice says participants _____ be at least 12 years old.
questions.explanation: must 表示強制要求與義務，最適合用於正式規定或公告中表達「必須」的條件。should 只是建議，力道不夠。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【情境題】媽媽跟小華說：「你不必今天打掃房間，明天再做也可以。」請選出最符合媽媽話語的英文句子。

Mom says, "You _____ clean your room today. You can do it tomorrow."
questions.explanation: do not have to 表示「不必、沒有義務」，與 must not（禁止）完全不同。此處媽媽給的是彈性，而非禁止，所以選 do not have to。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【變化題】Tom 剛到一個陌生城市，想問路。下列哪句話最有禮貌且語意最合適？
options: You must tell me the way to the station.
I should go to the station.
Can you tell me the way to the station, please?
You cannot go the wrong way.
questions.explanation: Can you...? 是詢問對方「能否」幫忙的禮貌請求句型，加上 please 更顯禮貌，最適合陌生人問路的情境。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【辨析題】下列哪個句子中，助動詞的使用是錯誤的？
options: She can plays the piano very well.
You must wear a helmet when riding a bike.
Should I bring an umbrella today?
He cannot swim across the river.
questions.explanation: 助動詞後面必須接動詞原形，"can plays" 是錯誤的，應改為 "can play"。其他三句助動詞用法皆正確。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】學校規定學生上課不能使用手機，但下課時間可以。請選出最能完整表達此規定的句子。
options: Students must not use phones during class, but they should use them during breaks.
Students cannot use phones during class, but they can use them during breaks.
Students should not use phones during class, but they must use them during breaks.
Students must use phones during class, but they cannot use them during breaks.
questions.explanation: cannot 表示上課時「禁止使用」，can 表示下課時「可以使用」，兩者搭配最精確表達學校規定的對比情境。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【應用題】醫生告訴病人：「你應該多休息，少吃油膩的食物。」請選出最符合醫生建議的英文句子。

The doctor says, "You _____ rest more and _____ eat greasy food."
questions.explanation: 醫生給的是「建議」而非強制命令，should 和 should not 最能表達建議語氣，語意最為貼切。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【易混淆辨析題】下列哪個句子使用了 must 表示「一定不是（否定推測）」？
options: He must not enter this room.
That must not be Tom — he is in Tokyo now.
You must not talk during the test.
She must not eat junk food.
questions.explanation: "That must not be Tom" 中的 must not 表示否定推測，意為「那一定不是 Tom」。其他三句的 must not 均表示禁止或規定。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【情境題】海報上寫著：「18歲以下不得購買菸酒。」請選出最符合規定的英文句子。

People under 18 _____ buy cigarettes or alcohol.
questions.explanation: must not 表示法律或規定上的嚴格禁止，最適合用於「不得購買」這類強制禁止的官方規定。should not 只是道德建議，語氣不足。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【變化題】Jenny 問媽媽是否可以養一隻狗。媽媽說：「你要先負責任地照顧它，然後我們再討論。」媽媽的意思最接近下列哪個句子？

Mom says, "You _____ show me you are responsible first."
questions.explanation: must 在此表示「必須先做到這件事」，是媽媽給的前提條件，帶有強制要求的語氣，語意最為符合。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【綜合辨析題】下列四個句子，哪一句中的助動詞表達的是「能力」而非「許可」或「義務」？
options: You can leave after you clean up.
questions.explanation: "She can speak Japanese fluently" 的 can 表示個人具備的語言能力。第一句和第三句的 can 表示許可，第四句的 must 表示義務。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【情境題】小明要描述他在颱風來臨前做的事。選出正確的連接詞填入空格：
He closed all the windows ______ the typhoon arrived.
questions.explanation: before 表示「在……之前」，颱風來之前先關窗，符合邏輯。after 表示「之後」、since 表示「自從」、until 表示「直到」，均不符情境。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【辨析題】下列哪個句子的介系詞用法正確？
options: She has been waiting since two hours.
She has been waiting for two hours.
She has been waiting during two hours.
She has been waiting from two hours.
questions.explanation: 表示「持續一段時間」要用 for，如 for two hours。since 後面接時間點（如 since 3 o'clock），during 後接某段事件，from 後通常接起點，皆不合此句型。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【應用題】選出能使句子語意完整且正確的選項：
You can borrow my bike ______ you return it by noon.
questions.explanation: as long as 表示「只要……就……」，帶有條件含義，符合語境。unless 表「除非」、even though 表「儘管」、in case 表「以防萬一」，語意均不符。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【變化題】選出語意最通順的句子：
options: We stayed inside because of it was raining.
We stayed inside because of the rain.
We stayed inside because of rained.
We stayed inside because of raining.
questions.explanation: because of 是介系詞片語，後面必須接名詞或名詞片語，如 the rain。because 才接子句（because it was raining），because of 不可直接接子句或動詞。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【辨析題】下列句子中，哪一句的連接詞使用有誤？
options: He is tired, but he keeps working.
Although she was sick, but she went to school.
She studied hard, so she passed the exam.
I will call you when I arrive.
questions.explanation: although 和 but 不可同時使用，兩者均表轉折，只能擇一。正確說法為 Although she was sick, she went to school. 或 She was sick, but she went to school.。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【應用題】選出正確完成句子的選項：
The students were excited ______ the field trip.
questions.explanation: be excited about 是固定搭配，表示「對……感到興奮」。be excited of/with/for 均非標準用法，此題測驗介系詞與形容詞的固定搭配。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【變化題】選出使句意最完整的連接詞：
______ my grandmother is 80 years old, she still walks to the market every day.
questions.explanation: although 引導讓步副詞子句，表示「雖然……但是……」，符合「儘管年邁仍堅持走路」的語意。despite 後接名詞，不接子句；because/since 表原因，語意不符。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【情境題】選出正確的介系詞：
The post office is ______ the bank and the bookstore.
questions.explanation: between 用於兩者之間（銀行和書店共兩個），among 用於三者或三者以上之間。around 表「圍繞」、through 表「穿過」，均不符合此空間位置的描述。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【應用題】選出正確填入的連接詞，使兩個動作的順序清楚：
She turned off the lights ______ she left the room.
questions.explanation: 她離開房間之前先關燈，用 before（在……之前）最符合語意。after 表「之後」順序相反；while 表同時進行；as soon as 表「一……就……」，語意略有差異。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【變化題】選出語意和文法均正確的句子：
options: I haven't seen him during three years.
I haven't seen him for three years.
I haven't seen him while three years.
I haven't seen him by three years.
questions.explanation: for 用來表示「持續多久」，搭配完成式，如 for three years。during 後接特定時間段（during the summer），while 引導子句，by 表期限，三者均不適用。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【情境題】選出正確的介系詞：
We will meet ______ Monday morning ______ 9 o'clock.
questions.explanation: 星期幾用 on（on Monday morning），幾點鐘用 at（at 9 o'clock）。in 用於月份、年份、較長時段；at 用於精確時間點；兩者搭配規則不同。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【辨析題】選出文法正確的句子：
options: Neither Tom or Jerry was invited.
Neither Tom nor Jerry was invited.
Either Tom nor Jerry was invited.
Both Tom or Jerry was invited.
questions.explanation: neither…nor… 是固定搭配，表示「兩者都不」。either…or… 表「兩者之一」；both…and… 表「兩者皆是」；neither…or… 和 either…nor… 均為錯誤搭配。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【情境題】選出最符合語境的連接詞：
Bring an umbrella ______ it rains on your way home.
questions.explanation: in case 表示「以防萬一」，帶雨傘是為了預防下雨的可能性，最符合情境。although/even if 表讓步、as long as 表條件，語意均不符合「預防」的概念。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【辨析題】下列何者不能填入空格？
______ the heavy traffic, she arrived on time.
questions.explanation: although 是連接詞，後面必須接完整子句（主詞＋動詞），不能直接接名詞片語 the heavy traffic。despite 和 in spite of 是介系詞片語，even with 也是介系詞用法，三者後面均可接名詞片語。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【應用題】選出正確的介系詞：
She is really good ______ playing the piano.
questions.explanation: be good at 是固定搭配，表示「擅長……」，後面接名詞或動名詞。be good for 表示「對……有益」；be good in 和 be good on 均非標準英語搭配。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【辨析題】選出正確完成對話的句子：
A: Why didn't you come to the party?
B: I stayed home ______ my little brother.
questions.explanation: to take care of 為不定詞片語表目的（為了照顧弟弟），是最自然正確的表達。in order to 後接原形動詞（不是 taking）；so that 後接子句；for 後接名詞而非直接接動名詞表此類目的。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】Linda 的媽媽問她有沒有吃早餐，Linda 回答說她已經吃過了。請選出正確的英語回答：
options: Yes, I have already eaten breakfast.
questions.explanation: 現在完成式用來表示「已經完成且與現在有關聯」的動作，結構為 have/has + 過去分詞。already 常用於現在完成式肯定句中，故選 B。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【辨析題】下列哪一句使用的時態「最不恰當」？
options: She has lived in Taipei for ten years.
He has gone to Japan last week.
We have already finished the project.
They have never tried sushi before.
questions.explanation: last week 是明確的過去時間點，必須搭配簡單過去式（He went to Japan last week），不可與現在完成式連用。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【填空情境題】Kevin: "Have you ever ________ to a live concert?"  Amy: "Yes, I have. It was amazing!"
questions.explanation: Have you ever + 過去分詞，詢問「有沒有曾經…的經驗」。go 的過去分詞為 gone，故填 gone。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【語意辨析題】"Tom has gone to London" 和 "Tom has been to London" 最主要的差異是什麼？選出最正確的說明：
options: 前者表示 Tom 曾去過倫敦但已回來，後者表示 Tom 現在還在倫敦。
兩句意思完全相同，可以互換。
前者表示 Tom 現在還在倫敦（或途中），後者表示 Tom 曾去過倫敦（現已回來）。
前者是過去式，後者是現在式。
questions.explanation: have gone to 表示「已去了還未回來」；have been to 表示「曾去過，現已回來」。此為常見易混淆考點。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【應用題】老師要求同學用 since 完成一個現在完成式的句子，下列哪一句完全正確？
options: I have learned English since five years.
I have learned English since I was seven years old.
I learned English since I was seven years old.
I have learned English since five years ago.
questions.explanation: since 後面接「時間點」，如 since I was seven 或 since 2015。「since + 一段時間」是錯誤的，那是 for 的用法；A、D 用法不當，C 主句時態錯誤。B 選項 since I was seven years old 結構最正確。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境應用題】Two friends are talking: "It's the first time I ________ Thai food. It tastes great!"
questions.explanation: 「It's the first/second time + 主詞 + have + 過去分詞」是固定句型，表示「這是第一次…」。故選 have ever tried。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【語法辨析題】選出與下列句子「時態用法相同」的選項："I have read this book three times."
options: He has just finished his homework.
They were playing basketball at 5 p.m.
questions.explanation: 題目句是現在完成式，表示「重複經驗/次數」。選項 B He has just finished his homework 同樣是現在完成式（表示剛完成），與題目時態相同。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【錯誤辨析題】下列句子中有一句含有文法錯誤，請選出它：
options: Have you finished your dinner yet?
She hasn't called me since last Monday.
They have met two days ago.
He has worked at this company for three years.
questions.explanation: two days ago 是明確的過去時間點，不可與現在完成式搭配，應改為 They met two days ago（簡單過去式）。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【問句轉換題】將下列句子改成問句："She has already packed her bags."  哪一個問句最正確？
options: Did she already pack her bags?
Has she packed her bags yet?
Has she already packed her bags yet?
Does she pack her bags yet?
questions.explanation: 現在完成式問句結構為 Have/Has + 主詞 + 過去分詞？且 yet 用於問句末尾，already 用於肯定句。A 為過去式問句，C 同時用 already 和 yet 不自然，D 為現在式。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境對話題】媽媽問小明："Have you done your homework?" 小明還沒做完，應如何正確回答？
options: No, I didn't do it yet.
No, I haven't done it yet.
No, I don't do it yet.
No, I wasn't done it yet.
questions.explanation: 現在完成式的否定回答為 No, I haven't + 過去分詞 + yet，表示「尚未完成」。yet 置於句尾，用於否定句和問句。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境理解題】The sign on the restaurant door says: "We have served over one million customers." What does this mean?
options: The restaurant will serve one million customers soon.
The restaurant served one million customers a long time ago and is now closed.
From the past until now, the restaurant has served more than one million customers.
The restaurant is serving one million customers right now.
questions.explanation: 現在完成式表示「從過去到現在」的累積結果，"have served over one million customers" 表示從開業至今已累積服務超過一百萬位顧客。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【字彙語法題】"My grandfather ________ in this town ________ he was born." 選出正確組合：
questions.explanation: since 後接時間點（he was born），且動作從過去持續到現在，須用現在完成式 has lived。for 後接時間長度，此處須用 since 接起點，故選 has lived / since。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【同義句替換題】"This is my first visit to Tainan." 下列哪一句意思最相近？
options: I visited Tainan for the first time.
I have never been to Tainan before.
I have been to Tainan many times.
questions.explanation: "This is my first visit" 表示從未去過、這次是第一次，等於 "I have never been to Tainan before"，兩者皆強調「之前從未有此經驗」。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【句子合併題】將兩句合併："Peter started working here in 2019. He still works here now." 最適合的現在完成式合併句是：
questions.explanation: 動作從 2019 年開始，持續到現在，用現在完成式 has worked。since 接時間點（2019），for 接時間長度（如 for five years）。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【閱讀理解題】Read the sentence: "By the time you arrive, I will have already left." Which tense is underlined — "will have already left"?
questions.explanation: "will have + 過去分詞" 是未來完成式（Future Perfect），表示在未來某個時間點之前將已完成的動作。此題考辨識能力，避免與現在完成式混淆。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【對話填空題】A: "You look tired. ________ you ________ enough sleep lately?" B: "No, I've been very busy."
questions.explanation: lately（最近）常與現在完成式搭配，問句結構為 Have you + 過去分詞？get 的過去分詞為 gotten（美式）或 got（英式），此處選 Have / gotten。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【排列組合題】將下列字詞排列成正確句子："never / I / have / spicy food / eaten / so"
options: I never have so spicy food eaten.
I have never eaten such spicy food.
I have never eaten so spicy food.
Never I have eaten so spicy food.
questions.explanation: 正確語序為 I have never eaten such spicy food.（現在完成式否定 + 修飾語）。"such" 修飾名詞（such spicy food），而 "so" 修飾形容詞或副詞，後不直接接名詞，故 so 須改為 such。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【語境判斷題】老師說："The bell has just rung. Please put your pens down." 老師使用現在完成式的原因最可能是：
options: 表示鈴聲在過去某個特定時間響起，與現在無關。
強調剛才鈴聲響起這件事對現在的影響（現在該放筆了）。
表示鈴聲曾經響過很多次。
表示鈴聲從過去持續響到現在。
questions.explanation: 現在完成式（has just rung）強調「剛發生的事對現在的影響或結果」，鈴聲剛響（動作剛完成），所以「現在」應該放筆，體現完成式與現在的連結。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【雙句比較題】下列兩句哪一組「時態使用」最符合前後語意邏輯？
options: A: Have you seen my keys? B: Yes, I saw them on the table just now.
A: Did you see my keys? B: Yes, I have seen them yesterday.
A: Have you seen my keys? B: Yes, I have seen them yesterday.
A: Did you see my keys just now? B: Yes, I have put them on the table.
questions.explanation: A 問「你有沒有看到我的鑰匙」用現在完成式（關心現在狀態），B 回答「剛才看到在桌上」用過去式（just now 是明確過去時間點），兩句搭配自然正確。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【進階應用題】Choose the sentence that uses the present perfect correctly to express an ongoing situation up to now:
options: The scientists discovered a new planet last year.
The scientists have been discovering a new planet for 200 years and they finished it.
The scientists have studied this planet for over 200 years and are still studying it today.
The scientists were studying this planet since the 1800s.
questions.explanation: 現在完成式可表示「從過去持續到現在仍在進行的狀況」。C 句 have studied...for over 200 years and are still studying it today，清楚表達動作從過去延續至今，是最正確的用法。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】小明看了一部新電影，想說「這部電影是由一位著名導演所執導的。」請選出正確的英文句子。
options: This movie directed by a famous director.
This movie was directed by a famous director.
This movie was directing by a famous director.
This movie is direct by a famous director.
questions.explanation: 被動語態結構為「be動詞 + 過去分詞」，動作發生在過去，故用 was directed by。選項A缺少be動詞，選項C用現在分詞directing錯誤，選項D用原形direct錯誤。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【辨析題】下列四個句子中，哪一句的被動語態「時態」使用正確？
options: The letter has been wrote yesterday.
The cake is being made right now.
The window was breaking last night.
questions.explanation: 「The cake is being made right now.」為現在進行式被動，結構是 is being + 過去分詞，正確。A缺少be動詞，B的過去分詞應為written，D應用broken而非breaking。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【應用題】學校廣播說：「明天的運動會因為下雨已被取消了。」以下哪個句子最符合此意？
options: Tomorrow's sports day has canceled because of rain.
Tomorrow's sports day was canceled because of rain.
Tomorrow's sports day has been canceled because of rain.
Tomorrow's sports day is canceled because of rain yesterday.
questions.explanation: 「已被取消」表示動作對現在有影響，應使用現在完成式被動：has been canceled。選項A缺少been，選項B用過去簡單式，無法表達「已經」的狀態，選項D時間副詞與現在式矛盾。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【變化題】主動句「Someone must fix this computer.」改為被動語態，下列何者正確？
options: This computer must fixed by someone.
This computer is must be fixed.
questions.explanation: 情態動詞後的被動結構為「情態動詞 + be + 過去分詞」，故為 must be fixed。by someone可省略（因為someone泛指無特定對象）。A缺少be，C用現在分詞，D多了is。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【易混淆題】下列哪個句子使用的是「被動語態」而非「連綴動詞 + 形容詞」的結構？
options: She looks tired after the long trip.
The door was closed by the student.
questions.explanation: 「The door was closed by the student.」是真正的被動語態，表示動作（有施事者by the student）。其餘選項都是連綴動詞（looks, smells, seems）接形容詞的句型，並非被動語態。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】朋友問你「這首歌是什麼時候寫的？」你該怎麼說？
questions.explanation: 被動語態疑問句結構：When + was/were + 主詞 + 過去分詞？song是單數故用was，write的過去分詞是written。選項A主詞缺失，C主詞與動詞不一致且wrote非過去分詞，D用原形write錯誤。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【應用題】以下哪個句子正確表達「這項計畫正在被委員會審查中。」？
options: The plan is reviewing by the committee.
The plan is being reviewed by the committee.
The plan was being review by the committee.
The plan has reviewed by the committee.
questions.explanation: 現在進行式被動結構為「is/are + being + 過去分詞」，故為 is being reviewed。A用現在分詞reviewing，C的過去分詞應為reviewed，D應為has been reviewed。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【辨析題】下列四個句子中，哪個句子裡「被動語態」與「時間副詞」搭配正確？
options: The bridge is built two years ago.
The bridge was built two years ago.
The bridge has been built two years ago.
The bridge will built two years ago.
questions.explanation: 「two years ago」是明確的過去時間點，必須搭配過去簡單式被動（was built）。現在完成式（has been）不可與ago連用，will built缺少be，is built與ago矛盾。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【變化題】主動句「People speak English in many countries.」改為被動語態，下列何者正確？
options: English is spoken in many countries.
English is speaking in many countries.
English was spoken in many countries by people.
questions.explanation: 泛指的施事者（People）改被動後通常省略by people。時態為現在簡單式，被動為 is spoken。選項B用現在分詞，選項C用過去式且保留by people不自然，選項D為主動語態。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】媽媽說：「晚餐還沒被煮好。」以下哪句最符合這個意思？
questions.explanation: 「還沒……」表示動作至今尚未完成，應用現在完成式被動的否定形式：hasn't been cooked yet。A缺少been，B用現在簡單式被動，D用過去式與yet搭配不自然。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【易混淆題】下列句子中，哪一句的「by片語」使用是多餘的（施事者不必要）？
options: The Eiffel Tower was designed by Gustave Eiffel.
The window was broken by Tom.
English is spoken by people in Australia.
The homework was done by the student.
questions.explanation: 「English is spoken in Australia.」已完整表達意思；加上「by people」是多餘的，因為people是泛指、無特定資訊。其他選項的施事者都提供了有意義的具體資訊。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【應用題】告示牌上寫著「禁止拍照」，以下哪個被動語態句子最能表達這個禁令？
options: Photos must not be taken here.
questions.explanation: 表達禁令用情態動詞must not，加上被動結構 be + 過去分詞，故為 must not be taken。B缺少be動詞，C和D都是陳述事實而非禁令。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【變化題】下列哪個句子正確將「They will announce the results tomorrow.」改為被動語態？
options: The results will be announced tomorrow.
The results will be announcing tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 未來式被動結構為「will + be + 過去分詞」，故為 will be announced。A缺少be，C用現在分詞，D用現在式與tomorrow矛盾。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】新聞報導：「據說總統將於明天訪問這座城市。」以下哪句符合此意？
options: The president is said to visit the city tomorrow.
The president is said visiting the city tomorrow.
The president was said to visit the city tomorrow.
The president says to visit the city tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 「據說……」可用被動語態結構：It is said that... 或 主詞 + is said + to V。此題為後者，is said to visit表示「據說將要……」，為標準用法。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【辨析題】下列哪個句子中「get + 過去分詞」正確表達了被動意義？
options: She got to promote last month.
questions.explanation: 「get + 過去分詞」是口語中常見的被動語態，表示某事發生在主詞身上。got promoted 表示「被升職了」。A用現在分詞，C用不定詞（意思不同），D用原形動詞，皆不正確。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【應用題】下列哪個句子正確表達「這本書很難被理解。」？
options: This book is hard to understand.
This book is hard to be understood.
This book is hard being understood.
questions.explanation: 「be hard to + 原形動詞」結構中，原形動詞本身已帶被動意義，不需另加被動形式。故「hard to understand」是正確且自然的說法。選項B的to be understood是錯誤用法，選項D意思變成「這本書幾乎不被理解」，語意不同。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【變化題】下列哪個選項正確將間接受詞提前改為被動語態？原句：「The teacher gave the students a test.」
options: A test was given the students by the teacher.
The students were given a test by the teacher.
The students given a test by the teacher.
A test given to the students by the teacher.
questions.explanation: 雙賓語句改被動可將直接或間接受詞作主詞。以間接受詞the students為主詞時，被動為「The students were given a test by the teacher.」，原直接受詞a test保留。A語序錯誤（a test當主詞時後面缺少介系詞to），C和D缺少be動詞。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【易混淆題】下列四句中，哪一句是「主動語態」但含有被動意義？
options: The car was repaired by a mechanic.
questions.explanation: 「The book reads easily.」在形式上是主動語態（reads），但語意上是被動的（這本書很容易被閱讀）。這類句型稱為「中間語態」，常見於表示特性的句子，如 This shirt washes well。其餘選項皆為明確的被動語態結構。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】醫生告訴病人：「你需要被手術。」以下哪個句子正確表達此意？
options: You need to be operated on.
questions.explanation: 「operate on someone」（為某人動手術）是固定片語，改為被動時介系詞on不可省略，故為 be operated on。選項A是主動語態（你需要去動手術，意思不同），選項C省略了on，選項D用being但語法不正確。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【辨析題】下列句子中，哪個句子的「by」不是表示施事者，而是表示其他意思？
options: The painting was created by Picasso.
The document was signed by the manager.
The parcel was delivered by 5 o'clock.
The song was written by a teenager.
questions.explanation: 「by 5 o'clock」中的by是介系詞，表示「在……之前/截止到……」的時間概念，並非施事者。其餘選項的by都引導出動作的執行者（施事者）：畢卡索、經理、一位青少年。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【情境題】小明在描述他養的那隻狗，請選出正確的句子。
The dog ______ bit the mail carrier was sent to the vet.
questions.explanation: 先行詞為 dog（動物），關係子句中缺少主詞，應用 which 或 that。此處選項中只有 which 符合；whom 用於人且作受格，whose 表所有格，who 用於人。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【辨析題】以下四句中，哪一句的關係代名詞用法「正確」？
options: She is the teacher who students respect the most.
She is the teacher which students respect the most.
She is the teacher whose students respect the most.
She is the teacher whom students respect the most.
questions.explanation: 先行詞為 the teacher（人），關係子句中 respect 需要受格，故用 whom。who 為主格；which 不用於人；whose 表所有格，語意不符。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【變化題】下列句子中，空格應填入什麼？
The house ______ roof was destroyed by the typhoon has been rebuilt.
questions.explanation: 空格後緊接名詞 roof，表示「那棟房子的屋頂」，需用所有格關係代名詞 whose。that 與 which 後接的是動詞或受詞，不能直接修飾名詞。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【應用題】合併以下兩句，選出最自然正確的版本。
原句：I met a man. His daughter won the gold medal.
合併句：I met a man ______.
options: who his daughter won the gold medal
whose daughter won the gold medal
that daughter won the gold medal
which daughter won the gold medal
questions.explanation: 合併時，his（所有格）被替換為 whose，形成 whose daughter won the gold medal，修飾先行詞 a man（人）。選項 A 重複了所有格，是常見錯誤。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【辨析題】下列哪個句子中的關係代名詞可以「省略」？
options: The book that was written by Dickens is very famous.
The book that I borrowed from the library is overdue.
The woman who lives next door is a doctor.
The cat whose tail is long is mine.
questions.explanation: 關係代名詞當「受格」時可以省略。選項 B 中 that 在子句裡是受格（I borrowed the book），可省略為 The book I borrowed...。其他選項的關係代名詞均為主格或所有格，不可省略。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】老師在課堂上給了一個例句，請選出「文法正確」的句子。
options: The students who homework was not done had to stay after class.
The students whose homework was not done had to stay after class.
The students which homework was not done had to stay after class.
The students that homework was not done had to stay after class.
questions.explanation: 先行詞為 students（人），空格後接名詞 homework，需要所有格，故用 whose。其他選項文法上均不正確：who/that/which 後面需要動詞，不能直接接名詞。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【變化題】下列何者為正確且自然的英文句子？
（提示：先行詞含有 the only）
options: She was the only one who understood the question.
She was the only one which understood the question.
She was the only one whom understood the question.
She was the only one whose understood the question.
questions.explanation: 先行詞為 the only one（人），關係子句中缺少主詞，應用主格 who。whom 為受格，whose 為所有格，which 不用於人，故答案為 who。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【應用題】請找出下列句子中，「關係代名詞使用錯誤」的句子。
options: This is the museum that was built in 1920.
He is the artist whom I admire most.
They found a wallet which owner was unknown.
The movie that we watched last night was boring.
questions.explanation: 選項 C 中 which owner 錯誤，因為 which 不能作所有格直接修飾名詞；應改為 whose owner。whose 可用於人或物的所有格。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【易混淆辨析題】下列哪個句子語意與文法「均正確」？
options: The child whom is crying needs help.
The child who is crying needs help.
The child which is crying needs help.
The child whose is crying needs help.
questions.explanation: 先行詞為 the child（人），關係子句中缺主詞，用主格 who。whom 為受格不可作主詞；which 指事物；whose 是所有格後需接名詞，不可接動詞。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【情境題】英文作文中合併句子，請選出正確答案。
原句：I know a girl. Everyone loves her.
合併：I know a girl ______.
questions.explanation: 合併後 her 被替換為關係代名詞，her 在子句中作受格（loves her），故用受格 whom。雖然口語中常用 who，但在正式書寫或會考中 whom 更為正確。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【變化題】下列句子空格應選哪個選項，使句意最完整正確？
The scientist ______ research changed the world received the Nobel Prize.
questions.explanation: 空格後緊跟名詞 research，表示「這位科學家的研究」，需用所有格關係代名詞 whose。who/whom 後需跟動詞，that 亦不能直接修飾名詞。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【應用題】閱讀下段對話，選出填入空格的正確答案。
A: Who is that man?
B: He is the professor ______ lecture we attended last week.
questions.explanation: 空格後為名詞 lecture，需所有格關係代名詞 whose（= the professor's lecture）。who/whom 後接動詞，which 不適用於人的所有格關係。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【易混淆辨析題】下列哪個句子「不需要」關係代名詞也文法正確且語意不變？
options: The man who is standing by the door is my uncle.
The award that she received was unexpected.
The teacher whose class I enjoy is leaving.
The boy who won the prize was very happy.
questions.explanation: 選項 B 中 that 作受格（she received the award），可省略為 The award she received...，語意不變。選項 A 和 D 的 who 是主格，省略後需改為分詞構句；選項 C 的 whose 是所有格，不可省略。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【情境題】請選出能正確完成句子的選項。
Is there anything ______ I can do to help you?
questions.explanation: 先行詞為 anything（事物/不定代名詞），應使用 that 而非 which（當先行詞為 anything、something、everything、nothing 等不定代名詞時，習慣上用 that）。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【辨析題】下列哪個句子「有文法錯誤」？
options: The boy that broke the window apologized.
The window that the boy broke was expensive.
The boy whose window was broken apologized.
The boy which broke the window apologized.
questions.explanation: which 不用於指人，應改為 who 或 that。選項 A、B、C 文法均正確，故答案為 D。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【變化題】合併以下兩句，選出文法最正確的版本。
原句：We stayed at a hotel. The hotel's service was excellent.
合併句：We stayed at a hotel ______.
questions.explanation: 合併後 the hotel's 被 whose 取代，形成 whose service was excellent。選項 A、B 多餘地保留了所有格 its，造成重複錯誤；選項 D 缺少所有格。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【易混淆辨析題】下列哪個選項「正確」填入空格？
She is one of those people ______ never give up.
questions.explanation: 先行詞為 people（人），關係子句中缺主詞（give up 的主詞），故用主格 who。注意 one of those people who + 複數動詞，是常見進階考點。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【情境題】Amy 正在日記裡描述她最近的煩惱。選出文法正確的句子。

Amy wrote in her diary: "I can't help _____ about the test tomorrow. I need _____ harder."
questions.explanation: 「can't help + Ving」是固定用法，表示「忍不住做某事」；「need + to V」表示「需要做某事」，故答案為 worrying / to study。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【辨析題】下列哪個句子語意與其他三句最不相同？
questions.explanation: 「stop to smoke」表示「停下來去抽菸（為了抽菸而停止其他動作）」；其他三句均表示「戒菸、停止抽菸」，語意完全相反。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【應用題】老師在課堂上問學生關於環保的看法。選出最符合文意的答案。

The teacher asked: "What do you suggest _____ to reduce plastic waste?"
A student replied: "I suggest _____ reusable bags."
questions.explanation: 「suggest + Ving」是固定用法，suggest 後面接動名詞而非不定詞；兩個空格均需接 Ving，故答案為 doing / bringing。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【變化題】選出語法正確且語意通順的句子。
options: I look forward to meet you at the party.
I look forward to meeting you at the party.
I look forward meeting you at the party.
I look forward to have met you at the party.
questions.explanation: 「look forward to」中的「to」是介系詞，不是不定詞符號，因此後面必須接動名詞（Ving），故答案為 meeting。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【情境題】Kevin 想請朋友幫他決定去哪裡吃飯。選出正確的句子。

Kevin said to his friend, "I can't decide _____ for dinner. Could you help me _____?"
questions.explanation: 「疑問詞 + to V」是名詞片語的固定結構，「where to go」正確；「help + (to) V」後接不定詞（to 可省略），故答案為 where to go / to decide。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【辨析題】下列四個句子中，哪一句的動詞用法有誤？
options: She enjoyed dancing at the concert.
He refused to lend me his bike.
They finished to clean the classroom.
We decided to go hiking this weekend.
questions.explanation: 「finish」後面必須接動名詞（Ving），不能接不定詞，正確說法應為「finished cleaning」。其餘句子均符合文法規則。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【應用題】下列選項中，哪一句在語意上最能表達「Lisa 試著打開窗戶，但沒有成功」？
options: Lisa tried to open the window.
Lisa tried not to open the window.
Lisa tried not opening the window.
questions.explanation: 「try + to V」表示「試圖做某事（但未必成功）」；「try + Ving」表示「試試看做某事（作為一種嘗試手段）」。題目強調嘗試但未成功，故用 try to open。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【變化題】Mrs. Chen 告訴學生學英文的好方法。選出文法與語意均正確的句子。

"_____ English every day is the best way _____ it well," said Mrs. Chen.
questions.explanation: 句首主詞位置可用動名詞（Ving），「Practicing English」作主詞；「the best way to V」是固定搭配，表示「做某事的最好方式」，故答案為 Practicing / to learn。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】下列哪一句最正確地表達「Brian 記得曾經把鑰匙放在桌上」？
options: Brian remembers to put his keys on the table.
Brian remembered putting his keys on the table.
Brian remembers putting his keys on the table.
Brian remembered to put his keys on the table.
questions.explanation: 「remember + Ving」表示「記得曾經做過某事（已發生）」；此句描述過去的記憶，主句需用過去式，故答案為 remembered putting。注意 C 選項雖用 Ving 但主句用現在式，語境較不符合「曾經放過」的過去回憶。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【辨析題】以下句子哪一個用法正確？
options: He made me to clean the room.
She let him to go home early.
They had us to redo the homework.
My mom got me to wash the dishes.
questions.explanation: 「make / let / have + 受詞 + 原形動詞」（不加 to）；而「get + 受詞 + to V」才需要加 to，故只有 D 正確。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【應用題】選出能正確填入下列對話空格的選項。

A: "Why did you come to school so early?"
B: "I came early _____ a good seat in the front row."
questions.explanation: 表達「目的」可用「to V」或「in order to V」；選項 A 的 for 後面若接動名詞表示目的則較不自然，選項 D 語法錯誤，故答案為 to get。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【變化題】選出與底線句意最相近的選項。

"It is no use asking him for help."

下列哪一句意思最接近？
options: It is useful to ask him for help.
Asking him for help is not useful.
He is not helpful at all.
We should ask him for help anyway.
questions.explanation: 「It is no use + Ving」是固定句型，表示「做某事是沒有用的」，與「Asking him for help is not useful.」語意最接近。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】下列哪個句子最正確地說明「這本書值得一讀再讀」？
options: This book is worth to read again and again.
This book is worthy reading again and again.
