This book is worth reading again and again.
This book is worth to be read again and again.
questions.explanation: 「be worth + Ving」是固定句型，worth 後面接動名詞而非不定詞，且主詞已是受事者，不需再被動，故答案為 worth reading。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【辨析題】選出文法正確的句子。
options: I was so tired that I avoided to speak to anyone.
She kept to try until she succeeded.
They enjoyed to play board games on weekends.
He admitted stealing the money from the drawer.
questions.explanation: 「admit」後接動名詞（Ving）；avoid、keep、enjoy 均需接 Ving，選項 A、B、C 均誤用了不定詞，故 D 為正確答案。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【應用題】學校通知欄上的公告。選出文法正確的版本。

"All students are required _____ the library rules. _____ in the library is not allowed."
questions.explanation: 「be required + to V」是固定被動用法；句首以動名詞（Ving）作主詞表示一般習慣性禁止，故答案為 to follow / Eating。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【情境題】Jack 和 Mia 在討論週末計畫。選出對話中正確的句子。

Jack: "I'm thinking of _____ to Jiufen this weekend."
Mia: "Great idea! I'd love _____ there, too."
questions.explanation: 「think of + Ving」是固定用法；「would love + to V」表示「很想做某事」，後接不定詞，故答案為 going / to go。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【變化題】選出與下列句子意思相同的選項。

"To be honest, he doesn't like the plan at all."
options: Honestly speaking, he doesn't like the plan at all.
Being honest, he doesn't like the plan at all.
For being honest, he doesn't like the plan at all.
In order to be honest, he doesn't like the plan at all.
questions.explanation: 「To be honest」是慣用的獨立不定詞片語，表示「說實話」，與副詞片語「Honestly speaking」語意最接近，兩者均可用來修飾整個句子。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【辨析題】下列哪個句子的不定詞或動名詞使用「具有主詞意義的所有格/受格」最正確？
options: I am sorry for him to leave so early.
I am sorry for him leaving so early.
I am sorry for he leaving so early.
I am sorry for he to leave so early.
questions.explanation: 介系詞 for 後面接動名詞片語時，動名詞的邏輯主詞應使用受格（him）或所有格（his），故「for him leaving」文法正確；選項 C、D 用主格 he 是錯誤的。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【情境題】選出能正確完成以下句子的選項。

"The coach encouraged the team _____ their best, even though _____ the championship seemed difficult."
questions.explanation: 「encourage + 受詞 + to V」是固定用法；第二個空格為句子的主詞位置，可用動名詞（Ving），故答案為 to do / winning。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
【變化題】閱讀下列句子，選出劃線部分在文法上功能相同的選項。

"Swimming in the ocean can be dangerous."
（Swimming 在此句中作為主詞）

下列哪句底線部分具有相同的文法功能？
options: She is swimming in the pool right now.
His dream is traveling around the world.
Reading books every day improves your vocabulary.
I saw him swimming near the rocks.
questions.explanation: 題目中 Swimming 作句子的主詞（動名詞主詞）；選項 C 的 Reading 同樣作句子的主詞；A 是現在進行式、B 的 traveling 作補語、D 的 swimming 作受詞補語，均非主詞功能。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】小明在圖書館想問館員某本書放在哪裡，他說：「Excuse me, could you tell me _____ the dictionary is?」請選出正確的間接問句。
questions.explanation: 間接問句須用陳述句語序（疑問詞＋主詞＋動詞），不可用疑問句語序。正確結構為 could you tell me + where + the dictionary（主詞）+ is（動詞）。選(A)(D)語序倒裝錯誤，(C)多了多餘的 it。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【辨析題】下列哪一句是正確的英語句子？
options: I wonder does he know the answer.
I wonder if he knows the answer.
I wonder if does he know the answer.
I wonder whether he know the answer.
questions.explanation: wonder 後接間接問句，必須用陳述句語序。(A)用疑問語序錯誤；(C)多了助動詞 does 且語序錯誤；(D)第三人稱單數動詞應為 knows。(B)語序正確、動詞正確，為唯一正確句。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【應用題】下列對話中，Mary 問了一個附加問句。請選出正確的版本：「You've never been to Japan, _____ ?」
questions.explanation: 附加問句規則：前句為否定，附加問句用肯定。主句含 never（現在完成式否定意義），附加問句須用肯定的 have you。(B)為前否後否錯誤，(C)(D)時態不符。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】老師問同學是否完成作業，下列哪個間接問句最符合文法？「Please tell me _____ your homework.」
questions.explanation: 間接問句須以陳述句語序呈現。whether/if 引導時，其後接主詞＋動詞。(A) if you have finished 語序完全正確。(B)疑問語序倒裝；(C)if 後又倒裝錯誤；(D)間接問句不用 did。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【辨析題】以下哪一個附加問句使用正確？「Let's go for a walk, _____ ?」
questions.explanation: 以 Let's 開頭的祈使句，附加問句固定用 shall we，這是英文慣用法，不可用其他形式。需特別記憶此特殊規則。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【易混淆辨析題】下列四句中，哪一句的間接問句「語序」正確？
options: She asked me what time does the store close.
She asked me what time the store closes.
She asked me what time is it now.
She asked me what time closes the store.
questions.explanation: 間接問句不使用疑問語序。正確結構：what time + 主詞（the store）+ 動詞（closes）。(A)有助動詞 does 倒裝，(C)is it 倒裝，(D)主詞動詞倒裝錯誤。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】Kevin 不確定他的朋友住在哪，他說：「I'm not sure _____ he lives.」請選最適合的字填入。
questions.explanation: 此句詢問的是「地點」，應用 where 引導。if 和 whether 只能引導「是否」的問句（yes/no question），不能引導有疑問詞的問句。that 不能引導問句。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【應用題】下列哪個句子中，附加問句使用正確？
options: Nobody called while I was out, did they?
Nobody called while I was out, didn't they?
Nobody called while I was out, did nobody?
Nobody called while I was out, were they?
questions.explanation: nobody、no one、nothing 等否定主詞視為否定句，附加問句用肯定形式，且代詞用 they（代替 nobody）。(B)前否後否錯誤，(C)附加問句不重複 nobody，(D)時態不符。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【變化題】Hannah 想問她的同學是否知道考試結果，她應該說：
options: Do you know what the results of the exam are?
Do you know what are the results of the exam?
You know what the results of the exam are, do you?
You know what are the results of the exam, don't you?
questions.explanation: Do you know... 後接間接問句，須用陳述語序：what + 主詞 + 動詞。(B)用疑問語序倒裝錯誤。(C)肯定句的附加問句應為 don't you；(D)間接問句語序錯誤。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【辨析題】Mary 早上看到 Tom 沒帶外套就出門，她說「It's cold today, _____ ?」，表示她認為 Tom 應該同意她的說法。
questions.explanation: 說話者陳述「今天很冷」是肯定句，並期待對方同意，附加問句應用否定形式 isn't it。時態為現在式，排除 was/wasn't。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】旅客問服務台：「Could you tell me _____ the next bus to the city center leaves?」
questions.explanation: 間接問句中 when 直接引導陳述語序，不需助動詞 does。(A)語序倒裝錯誤；(B)不需 that；(D)問的是時間而非地點，意思錯誤。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【易混淆辨析題】以下關於附加問句的敘述，哪一個正確？「Everything is ready, _____ ?」
questions.explanation: everything 雖然意義上包含多個事物，但文法上視為單數（第三人稱單數），代詞用 it，附加問句為 isn't it。不可用 they。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【應用題】下列哪一句間接問句中，if 和 whether 的用法有明顯區別？
options: I don't know if/whether she will come.
I want to know whether or not she will come.
Tell me if/whether you need help.
I'm not sure if/whether it's true.
questions.explanation: whether or not 是固定搭配，緊接 or not 時 if 不能直接說 if or not。因此只有 whether or not 為正確用法，此為 if 和 whether 最明確的使用區別；其餘三句 if/whether 可互換。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【變化題】老師對全班說：「Open your books, _____ ?」請選出正確的附加問句。
questions.explanation: 對第二人稱（you）的祈使句，附加問句通常用 will you（或 won't you 表禮貌請求）。shall we 用於 Let's 句型；don't you / do you 為錯誤用法。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【辨析題】下列哪一句是「正確」的英語句子？
options: Can you tell me where does the post office is?
Can you tell me where the post office is?
Can you tell me where is the post office is?
Can you tell me where is the post office?
questions.explanation: 間接問句中 where 引導陳述語序，正確為 where + 主詞 + 動詞：where the post office is。(A)多餘 does；(C)動詞 is 重複；(D)語序倒裝錯誤。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】Amy 不知道她的哥哥何時回家，她想告訴媽媽：「I don't know _____ brother will be home.」
questions.explanation: 間接問句以 when 引導，後接陳述語序（主詞＋助動詞＋動詞）。正確為 when my brother will be home。(A)將 will 提前成疑問語序錯誤；(C)(D)結構冗餘且錯誤。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【易混淆辨析題】下列句子中，哪一個間接問句「不」正確？
options: She wants to know how long it takes to get there.
He asked me how much did the bag cost.
I wonder how many students passed the test.
Can you tell me how often the train runs?
questions.explanation: (B) He asked me how much did the bag cost，間接問句不用疑問語序，did 不應出現，正確應為 how much the bag cost。其餘三句語序均正確。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】兩個同學討論誰應該先報告，其中一人說：「It's your turn to present, _____ ?」，想再次確認。
questions.explanation: 主句為肯定陳述句（It's...），附加問句用否定形式 isn't it，代詞 it 代替主詞 it。(A)為肯定接肯定，與規則相反；(C)(D)附加問句不可重複主詞。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【變化題】下列哪一句話，間接問句後的主句語序「完全正確」？
options: Do you know how did she solve the problem?
Do you know how she solved the problem?
Do you know how she did solved the problem?
Do you know how solve she the problem?
questions.explanation: 間接問句由 how 引導，後接主詞＋動詞的陳述語序。正確為 how she solved the problem。(A)用疑問語序 did 倒裝錯誤；(C)did solved 雙重過去式錯誤；(D)主詞動詞顛倒。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: be 動詞與一般動詞現在式
questions.stem: Mary _____ in Taipei, but her parents _____ in Tainan.
questions.explanation: 主詞為第三人稱單數 Mary，用 lives；her parents 為複數，用 live。注意主詞數不同，選項易混淆。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: be 動詞與一般動詞現在式
questions.stem: Look at this sentence and find the error: 'Kevin and his sister goes to the same school every day.'
questions.explanation: Kevin and his sister 是複數主詞，動詞應改為 go，不可加 -s。此為辨錯題型，考生易被複合主詞迷惑。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: be 動詞與一般動詞現在式
questions.stem: Which sentence is CORRECT?
options: Does she likes cats or dogs?
Do he play basketball on weekends?
questions.explanation: 第三人稱單數否定句用 doesn't + 原形動詞，He doesn't know 正確。其餘選項助動詞與動詞形式均有誤。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: be 動詞與一般動詞現在式
questions.stem: Peter: 'What _____ your little brother like to eat?' Amy: 'He _____ pizza every Friday night.'
questions.explanation: 疑問句主詞 your little brother 為第三人稱單數，助動詞用 does；回答句主詞 He 搭配一般動詞第三人稱單數 eats。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: be 動詞與一般動詞現在式
questions.stem: There _____ a cat and two dogs in the yard right now.
questions.explanation: There be 句型中，be 動詞由緊接其後的名詞決定；最近名詞 a cat 為單數，故用 is。此為就近原則考點。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: be 動詞與一般動詞現在式
questions.stem: Which sentence uses 'are' INCORRECTLY?
options: Linda and Tom are good friends.
We are ready for the exam.
questions.explanation: news 雖字尾有 s，但為不可數單數名詞，be 動詞應用 is。此為形似複數但實為單數的名詞辨析題。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: be 動詞與一般動詞現在式
questions.stem: Jenny _____ her homework after dinner, but today she _____ very tired and just watches TV.
questions.explanation: 主詞 Jenny 為第三人稱單數，一般動詞用 does，be 動詞用 is。測驗同一句中 be 動詞與一般動詞同時辨析。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: be 動詞與一般動詞現在式
questions.stem: Which question is CORRECTLY formed?
options: Is your parents at home now?
Are your parents at home now?
questions.explanation: your parents 為複數，be 動詞疑問句應用 Are，選項 C 正確。選項 A、D 用 Is 搭配複數主詞，選項 B 謂語與主詞單複數不對應。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: be 動詞與一般動詞現在式
questions.stem: Ben usually _____ to school by bus, but his dad _____ him to school when it rains.
questions.explanation: 兩個主詞 Ben 和 his dad 皆為第三人稱單數，動詞均加 -s。測驗一句中連續出現兩個第三人稱單數主詞的一般動詞變化。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: be 動詞與一般動詞現在式
questions.stem: Sara: 'Is Eric a good student?' Tom: '_____'
options: Yes, he is a good student.
questions.explanation: 問句含 be 動詞 Is，回答應用 Yes, he is 或接完整敘述句。用 does 是回答一般動詞疑問句的格式，此處錯誤。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: be 動詞與一般動詞現在式
questions.stem: Which sentence is INCORRECT?
options: The students in our class are very smart.
Each of the boys has a dictionary.
questions.explanation: Everybody/everyone 等字意思為「每個人」，視為單數，be 動詞應用 is，不可用 are。此為易混淆的不定代名詞考點。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: be 動詞與一般動詞現在式
questions.stem: The soccer team _____ very hard before the big game.
questions.explanation: 集合名詞 team 在美式英語及台灣教材中視為單數，動詞加 -s 用 practices。選項 C、D 形式均錯誤。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: be 動詞與一般動詞現在式
questions.stem: Justin _____ comic books, but he _____ not interested in novels.
questions.explanation: Justin 為第三人稱單數，一般動詞 love 加 -s；後半句需 be 動詞 is（not interested 為形容詞補語）。測驗 be 動詞與一般動詞同句辨析。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: be 動詞與一般動詞現在式
questions.stem: _____ your cousin _____ English well?
questions.explanation: 以 Does 構成一般動詞疑問句時，後面動詞須還原為原形 speak，不可再加 -s。選項 C 的 speaks 為常見錯誤。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: be 動詞與一般動詞現在式
questions.stem: Mia and I _____ best friends. We _____ to the same after-school class together.
questions.explanation: Mia and I 為複數第一人稱，be 動詞用 are；主詞 We 也是複數，一般動詞用原形 go，不加 -s。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: be 動詞與一般動詞現在式
questions.stem: Which sentence expresses a GENERAL TRUTH correctly?
options: The sun rise in the east.
The Earth moves around the sun.
questions.explanation: 表達科學事實（一般真理）使用現在式。The Earth moves 主詞第三人稱單數動詞正確加 -s；其他選項動詞形態均有誤。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: be 動詞與一般動詞現在式
questions.stem: Amy _____ her bedroom clean, and her brother Kevin _____ his room messy all the time.
questions.explanation: Amy 與 her brother Kevin 均為第三人稱單數主詞，動詞均應加 -s，兩空皆為 keeps。測驗連續兩個第三人稱單數主詞的一致性。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: be 動詞與一般動詞現在式
questions.stem: Read the conversation: Teacher: 'Why _____ Tom always late?' Student: 'Because he _____ the first bus and _____ a long way to school.' Choose the correct form.
questions.explanation: 第一空 Why is Tom always late 用 be 動詞 is；後兩空主詞 he 為第三人稱單數，一般動詞 miss 和 walk 均加 -s。本題綜合測驗 be 動詞、副詞 always 及一般動詞第三人稱單數的複合應用。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: Mary and her sister are looking for _____ backpacks. They left them on the bus.
questions.explanation: 空格後有名詞 backpacks，需用形容詞性所有格 their（她們的）來修飾名詞。they 是主格，them 是受格，theirs 是名詞性所有格，後面不接名詞。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: A: Whose notebook is this? B: It's not mine. Maybe it's _____.
questions.explanation: 表示「某人的（東西）」，若主語是人名，需在名字後加 's 構成所有格（Kevin's）。of + 名詞的結構在此不符合英語習慣。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: The dog hurt _____ leg when it jumped off the wall.
questions.explanation: 主語 the dog 是單數動物，用所有格 its（它的）。注意 it's 是 it is 的縮寫，並非所有格，這是最常見的混淆陷阱。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: Look at these two paintings. _____ is beautiful, but I like the one on the left more.
questions.explanation: both of 後面接受格代名詞 them（指代已提及的兩幅畫）。their 是形容詞性所有格需接名詞，theirs 和 they 不符合 both of + 代名詞受格的句型。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: My brother and _____ are going to the science fair together this weekend.
questions.explanation: and 連接的並列主語需用主格。雖然口語常說 me，但正式英語（會考程度）應用主格 I。「My brother and I」作為整體主語是正確用法。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: The teacher told Tom and _____ to stay after class.
questions.explanation: told 是及物動詞，Tom and _____ 整體作受詞，應用受格 me。許多學生誤用主格 I，但在受詞位置必須用 me。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: These shoes are too small for Lisa. She needs a bigger pair. The small ones aren't _____.
questions.explanation: 句末沒有接名詞，需用名詞性所有格（獨立所有格）hers 代替「her shoes」。her 是形容詞性所有格，後面必須接名詞。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: Jason fell off his bike and hurt _____. He couldn't walk home.
questions.explanation: 主語 Jason（he）和受詞是同一人，表示「傷了自己」，要用反身代名詞 himself。him 指的是另一個人，語意不同。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: A: Is this your umbrella? B: No, mine is blue. This one must be _____.
questions.explanation: 「別人的」是 someone else's，所有格 's 加在 else 後面，這是固定用法。someone's else 和 else someone's 語序錯誤。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: The students painted the classroom _____. The teacher didn't help at all.
questions.explanation: 「靠自己、獨力完成」用 by + 反身代名詞（by themselves）。這是固定片語，不可使用所有格或其他介系詞替換。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: A boy and a girl are sitting in the park. _____ is reading a book; _____ is drawing.
questions.explanation: 兩個空格都是句子的主語，需用主格 he 和 she。his / her 是所有格，him / her 中 him 是受格，都不能作主語。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: My grandparents live by _____. No one else lives with them.
questions.explanation: 「獨居、獨自生活」用 live by oneself（反身代名詞），複數主語 they 對應 themselves。their own 後面需接名詞（如 their own house），不能單獨作補語。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: I can't find my pencil. Can I borrow _____?
questions.explanation: borrow 是及物動詞，受詞指代對方的鉛筆，但後面無名詞，需用名詞性所有格 yours（你的那支）代替 your pencil。your 後必須接名詞。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: The class voted for _____ favorite singer in a fun activity last Friday.
questions.explanation: 空格後有名詞 favorite singer，需用形容詞性所有格 their 來修飾。they 是主格，them 是受格，theirs 是名詞性所有格，均不能直接修飾名詞。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: David said the winning idea was _____. But Amy said she thought of it first.
questions.explanation: be 動詞後作表語（主詞補語），且後面無名詞，需用名詞性所有格 his（他的點子）。him 是受格，he 是主格，himself 是反身代名詞，均不符語境。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: Those children cleaned up the beach _____ last Sunday. Their teacher was very proud.
questions.explanation: 「靠自己、自行完成」的片語是 on one's own，所有格隨主語變化，複數第三人稱用 their。on theirs own 和 on them own 均為錯誤結構，on their selves 亦為錯誤搭配（應為 by themselves）。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: Mary wants to buy _____ umbrella because it is raining outside.
questions.explanation: umbrella 以母音音素 /ʌ/ 開頭，冠詞應用 an 而非 a。句中為泛指「一把」雨傘，故選 an。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: Look at the picture. _____ boy on the left is my brother.
questions.explanation: 圖中已有特定指涉對象（左邊那個男孩），為特定名詞前用定冠詞 the。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: Which sentence uses articles CORRECTLY?
options: He plays a piano every day.
We saw an elephant at the zoo.
I need the advice from you.
questions.explanation: elephant 以母音音素 /ɛ/ 開頭，搭配 an 正確。honest 雖拼音 h 開頭但發音為母音，應用 an；piano 為樂器演奏應說 the piano；advice 為不可數名詞，此處泛指不加定冠詞。故 C 正確。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: There are three _____ in the classroom. They are very tall.
questions.explanation: child 為不規則複數，正確形式是 children，不可加 -s 或 -es。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: Kevin has two _____ and one _____.
questions.explanation: watch 以 -ch 結尾，複數加 -es 變 watches；空格二為單數 one knife，維持原形。故選 watches / knife。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: My father bought me _____ new pair of shoes yesterday.
questions.explanation: pair 以子音音素 /p/ 開頭，為泛指「一雙」，使用不定冠詞 a。a pair of shoes 是固定用法。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: The students in our class love music. _____ music makes them happy.
questions.explanation: music 為抽象不可數名詞，泛指「音樂」這件事時不需要冠詞。若特指某首音樂才用 the。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: Which of the following is WRONG?
questions.explanation: rice 為不可數名詞，沒有複數形式，不能寫成 rices。正確說法是 four bags of rice。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: I have _____ dog. _____ dog's name is Lucky.
questions.explanation: 第一次提到 dog 用不定冠詞 a；第二次再提已是特定對象，改用定冠詞 the。此為冠詞初提與再提的經典用法。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: There _____ a lot of people at the party last night.
questions.explanation: a lot of people 意指複數，時態為過去式，故用 were。此題考複數主詞與過去式 be 動詞的搭配。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: She wants to be _____ engineer when she grows up.
questions.explanation: engineer 以母音音素 /ɛ/ 開頭，泛指職業時用不定冠詞，且應搭配 an 而非 a。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: How many _____ does Tom have?
questions.explanation: tooth 的複數為不規則變化 teeth，不可加 -s。how many 後接可數名詞複數。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: _____ sun rises in the east.
questions.explanation: 太陽是獨一無二的自然天體，前面固定加定冠詞 the。類似用法還有 the moon、the earth。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: We need to buy _____ furniture for our new house.
questions.explanation: furniture 為不可數名詞，不可用 a few（修飾可數）、many（修飾可數複數）或不定冠詞 a；some 可修飾不可數名詞，為正確選項。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: My teacher plays _____ violin very well. She learned it in Italy.
questions.explanation: 演奏樂器前通常加定冠詞 the，如 play the piano / the violin。這是固定用法，不用不定冠詞。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: There is _____ water in the bottle, but not enough.
questions.explanation: water 為不可數名詞，a little 用於修飾不可數名詞表「一點點」；a few 與 many 修飾可數複數名詞，不適用。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: Those _____ on the shelf are all very interesting.
questions.explanation: Those 為複數指示詞，後面必須接可數名詞複數形式 books。a book 為單數，the book 為單數，皆與 Those 不搭配。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: Linda is talking on the phone right now. Which sentence best describes what she is doing?
options: Linda talks on the phone every day.
Linda is talking on the phone now.
Linda talk on the phone at this moment.
Linda does talk on the phone now.
questions.explanation: 描述「此刻正在進行」的動作須用現在進行式 be + V-ing。選項A為簡單現在式(習慣)；選項C主詞後缺be動詞；選項D為強調語氣，用於強調事實，非進行中動作。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 情境:媽媽正在廚房煮飯,爸爸正在客廳看電視。請選出能同時正確描述這兩件事的句子。
options: Mom cooks in the kitchen and Dad watches TV in the living room.
Mom is cooking in the kitchen and Dad is watching TV in the living room.
Mom is cooking in the kitchen and Dad watches TV in the living room.
Mom cooks in the kitchen and Dad is watching TV in the living room.
questions.explanation: 兩個動作都是「此刻同時進行中」，必須全部使用現在進行式。選項B兩個動詞都是be+V-ing，符合語境；其他選項混用了簡單現在式，邏輯不一致。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: Choose the sentence that uses the present progressive correctly to express a TEMPORARY situation.
options: He is staying at a hotel this week because his house is being repaired.
I am understanding the problem now.
questions.explanation: 現在進行式可表示「暫時性」的狀態，如「這週暫時住飯店」是完全正確的用法。know、want、understand 屬於狀態動詞（stative verbs），通常不用進行式，故A、C、D皆錯。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: Which sentence is NOT correct?
options: The baby is sleeping quietly in the room.
Are your parents coming to the party tonight?
I am having a great time at the beach.
He is having a car, so he drives to work.
questions.explanation: have 表示「擁有」時是狀態動詞，不能用進行式，應改為 He has a car。have 表示「體驗、享受」時（如 have a great time）才可用進行式，故選項C正確。題目問哪個句子「不正確」，故選D。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: Mary: "Where is Tom?" Sue: "He _______ in the library. He has a test tomorrow."
questions.explanation: 回答「他現在在圖書館讀書」是描述此刻進行的動作，用現在進行式 is studying。選項B is study 缺少 -ing；選項D主詞 He 為第三人稱單數，應用 is 而非 are。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: Which question correctly asks about an action happening RIGHT NOW?
questions.explanation: 詢問「她現在正在做飯嗎？」須用現在進行式的疑問句型 Is + 主詞 + V-ing。選項A為簡單現在式疑問；選項C為現在完成式；選項D為過去式。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: Read the conversation: "Call me back later. I _______ a meeting right now." Which option best completes the sentence?
questions.explanation: 此處 have a meeting 意指「正在開會中」是一種進行中的活動（非單純「擁有」），可以使用進行式。選項A簡單現在式無法表達「此刻正進行中」的緊迫感；選項C、D時態不符。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 下列何者是現在進行式用來表示「近期已確定的未來計畫」的正確用法？
options: She is flying to Tokyo next Monday. (She already has the ticket.)
She is flying to Tokyo yesterday.
She flies to Tokyo next Monday usually.
She will be flying to Tokyo now.
questions.explanation: 現在進行式可表示「已安排好的近未來計畫」，如已買機票的出行計畫。選項A符合此用法；選項B時間副詞 yesterday 與進行式矛盾；選項C usually 表習慣，用簡單現在式；選項D will be flying 為未來進行式，且與 now 矛盾。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: Which sentence uses the negative form of the present progressive CORRECTLY?
questions.explanation: 現在進行式的否定形式為 be動詞 + not + V-ing。選項B they aren't playing 結構正確；選項A be動詞與not位置顛倒；選項C、D誤用了do助動詞，進行式否定不加do。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: Eric: "What are the kids doing?" Mom: "Jason _______ video games and Amy _______ a book."
questions.explanation: 問句使用了 what are...doing，表示詢問此刻正在做的事，回答也應統一使用現在進行式。兩個動作同時發生，故 is playing 和 is reading 並列才完整正確。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: Which of the following shows the CORRECT spelling of the present progressive form?
questions.explanation: make 去掉字尾 e 再加 -ing，拼為 making，正確。sit→sitting（雙寫t）；run→running（雙寫n）；stop→stopping（雙寫p），選項A、B、D均拼錯。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: Amy always _______ her homework after school, but today she _______ TV because it is a holiday.
questions.explanation: always 搭配簡單現在式表習慣（does）；today 加上「因為是假日」的情境，表示今天此刻正在做的例外行為，用現在進行式（is watching）。兩種時態對比是本題考查重點。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: Choose the sentence where the present progressive is used INCORRECTLY.
options: The river is flowing faster than usual after the rain.
Look! The dog is chasing the cat in the garden.
Water is boiling at 100 degrees Celsius.
Dad is washing the car in the driveway right now.
questions.explanation: 「水在100°C沸騰」是科學事實，屬於永恆真理，應用簡單現在式 Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius，不能用進行式。其餘三句均描述正在發生的動態動作，進行式正確。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: The coach said, "Everyone, pay attention! Kevin _______ the ball the wrong way. Watch him carefully."
questions.explanation: 教練提醒大家注意「Kevin 現在正在以錯誤方式踢球」，這是當下正在進行的動作，用現在進行式 is kicking。簡單現在式 kicks 表示習慣；kicked 是過去；will kick 是未來，均不符合語境。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: Which sentence correctly uses the present progressive to show that two actions are happening AT THE SAME TIME?
options: While she sang, he is playing the guitar.
She is singing while he is playing the guitar.
She sings while he is playing the guitar.
While she is singing, he played the guitar.
questions.explanation: 兩個同時發生的進行中動作，應在同一句中統一使用現在進行式。選項B兩個子句都用 is V-ing，時態一致且正確；其他選項混用了不同時態，導致邏輯矛盾。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: Wendy is very busy. She _______ three things at the same time: she _______ on the phone, _______ notes, and _______ the door for the delivery.
options: is doing / is talking / taking / holding
is doing / talking / is taking / is holding
is doing / is talking / taking / is holding
questions.explanation: 整句描述 Wendy 此刻同時進行的多項動作，主要動詞用 is doing，後面並列的三個動作共用同一個 is，結構為 is talking / taking / holding（後兩個省略 is）。選項B符合英文並列簡化原則，同時全部為進行式。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 下列關於現在進行式的描述，何者「錯誤」？
options: 可以表示說話當下正在發生的動作。
可以表示近期已安排好的未來計畫。
可以用 know、love、own 等狀態動詞的進行式形式描述感情狀態。
在否定句中，be 動詞後加 not，不需要加助動詞 do。
questions.explanation: know（知道）、love（愛）、own（擁有）屬於狀態動詞，描述持續的心理或所有狀態，通常不使用進行式。說「I am knowing you」是錯誤的，應用 I know you。選項A、B、D的描述均正確。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: Read the short story: "It is 7 p.m. The sun _______ (set) in the west. The birds _______ (return) to their nests. Tom _______ (sit) on the balcony and _______ (enjoy) the view." Which option correctly fills in ALL the blanks?
options: is setting / is returning / is sitting / is enjoying
is setting / returns / is sitting / enjoys
sets / is returning / sits / is enjoying
questions.explanation: 整段描述「此刻7點鐘正在發生的景象」，四個動作均為當下進行中，應全部使用現在進行式。選項B四個動詞均正確使用 is + V-ing，完整呈現同一時間點的動態畫面。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
Mary 想知道她的朋友在哪裡。請選出正確的句子。
Mary asks her friend: "________ are you going after school?"
questions.explanation: 詢問「去哪裡」要用 where。What 問事物，When 問時間，Who 問人物，均不符合語意。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
Tom 想知道派對是什麼時候。請選出正確的疑問詞。
"________ is the party?" "It's on Saturday evening."
questions.explanation: 回答 Saturday evening 是時間，因此疑問詞用 when。注意不要和 where（地點）混淆。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
老師問班上是誰打破了窗戶。請選出正確的疑問詞。
"________ broke the window?" "It was Peter."
questions.explanation: 回答 It was Peter（人名），疑問詞應為 who（詢問人）。Whose 問所有格，不符。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
媽媽問 Lisa 書包是誰的。請選出正確的疑問詞。
"________ backpack is this?" "It's mine."
questions.explanation: 問所有權「誰的」要用 whose。whose + 名詞構成所有格疑問句，是常見考點。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 下列對話中，疑問詞使用正確的是哪一個？
options: "What time does the movie start?" "At 7 p.m."
"Who time does the movie start?" "At 7 p.m."
"Whose time does the movie start?" "At 7 p.m."
"Where time does the movie start?" "At 7 p.m."
questions.explanation: 詢問幾點用 what time，是固定搭配。其他選項的疑問詞均不能與 time 搭配使用。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
Kevin 有三隻狗，你想知道他最喜歡哪一隻。請選出最合適的疑問詞。
"________ dog do you like best?"
questions.explanation: 在有限範圍內做選擇時用 which（哪一個）；what 通常用在開放性問題。三隻中選一隻，應用 which。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
Sandy 問她弟弟在做什麼。請選出正確的句子。
"________ are you doing?" "I'm reading a comic book."
questions.explanation: 回答「在看漫畫書」是動作/事物，疑問詞用 what。what + be + 主詞 + doing 是問進行中動作的常見句型。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 下列哪個問句的疑問詞和回答意思不符合？
options: "Why are you late?" "Because I missed the bus."
"How do you go to school?" "I go by bus."
"When did you eat lunch?" "I ate at home."
"Where is the library?" "It's next to the park."
questions.explanation: When 詢問時間，回答應為時間點（如 at noon），但 I ate at home 是回答地點，答非所問。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
Amy 問她同學為什麼沒來上課。請選出正確的句子。
"________ didn't you come to class yesterday?"
questions.explanation: 詢問原因用 why，對應的回答通常以 because 開頭。how 問方式，what 問事物，when 問時間，均不符。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
David 想知道他的同學是怎麼去圖書館的。請選出正確的疑問詞。
"________ do you go to the library?" "I walk there."
questions.explanation: 回答 I walk there 是交通/方式，疑問詞應用 how（詢問方式）。不要和 where（地點）混淆。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
媽媽問 Ben 把鑰匙放在哪裡了。請選出文法正確且語意合適的句子。
"________ did you put the keys?"
questions.explanation: put（放）涉及地點，疑問詞應為 where（在哪裡）。where did + 主詞 + 動詞原形 是標準過去式疑問句型。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 下列哪個句子的語序（word order）是正確的？
questions.explanation: wh- 疑問句語序為：疑問詞 + 助動詞 + 主詞 + 動詞。be 動詞提前，主詞在 be 動詞之後。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
老師問 Eric 上週末做了什麼。請選出正確的句子。
"________ did you do last weekend?"
questions.explanation: 詢問「做了什麼事」用 what，搭配 do 構成 what did + 主詞 + do 的結構。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 對話情境：Anna 有兩個書包，一個紅色、一個藍色，你想知道她喜歡哪一個。請選出最自然的問法。
questions.explanation: 兩個選項中選一個，用 which（哪一個）。what 適合開放問題，此情境已限定範圍，which 更精確。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 下列疑問句中，何者詢問的是「數量」？
options: How many students are in your class?
questions.explanation: how many + 可數名詞 詢問數量（幾個）。how often 問頻率，how 問狀態，how far 問距離，均非數量。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 小明想知道他的好朋友叫什麼名字。以下哪個問句最合適？
questions.explanation: 詢問「名字是什麼」用 what（what is your name）是固定句型。名字是事物，用 what，而非 who。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
Tony 問他媽媽晚餐要吃什麼。請選出正確且自然的問句。
"________ are we having for dinner tonight?"
questions.explanation: 問「吃什麼」是詢問事物，用 what。have something for dinner 是吃某物當晚餐的表達，疑問詞用 what。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
以下對話中，空格內應填入的疑問詞為何？
"________ does your sister look like?" "She's tall and has long hair."
questions.explanation: 詢問外貌描述用 what does ... look like（長什麼樣子）。how 問狀態或感受，不用於詢問外觀特徵。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: Mary ______ her homework before dinner yesterday, so she could watch TV afterward.
questions.explanation: yesterday 明確指出過去時間點，應使用過去式。finish 為規則動詞，過去式加 -ed 變為 finished。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: Kevin ______ to the library three times last week, but he ______ any books.
questions.explanation: 兩個動作都在 last week（過去），go 的過去式為不規則的 went；否定句用 didn't + 原形動詞 borrow。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: The children ______ very excited when they ______ the surprise gift.
questions.explanation: 描述過去情緒用 were（be 動詞複數過去式）；see 為不規則動詞，過去式為 saw，兩個子句均為過去時態。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 下列哪個句子的動詞時態使用「正確」？
options: She catched the bus just in time this morning.
He didn't went to school yesterday because he was sick.
They built a sandcastle on the beach last Sunday.
We buyed new shoes at the mall last weekend.
questions.explanation: build 的過去式為不規則的 built，句子正確。catch → caught（非 catched）；didn't + 原形動詞 go（非 went）；buy → bought（非 buyed）。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: A: Did your sister ______ English in college? B: No, she ______ French instead.
questions.explanation: Did 問句後動詞須還原為原形 study；答句描述過去事實，用 studied（規則動詞）。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 選出「語意與時態均正確」的句子。
options: I am so hungry. I didn't eat anything since morning.
The museum was close when we arrived, so we left.
He wore his new jacket to the party last night.
She telled me a funny story at lunch today.
questions.explanation: wear 的過去式為不規則的 wore，句意通順且時態正確。close 作形容詞應用 closed；tell 的過去式為 told（非 telled）；第一句 since morning 需搭配完成式。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: Last summer, Jason ______ the whole night to prepare for his speech and finally ______ first prize.
questions.explanation: Last summer 確立過去時態；stay up 為規則動詞加 -ed → stayed up；win 為不規則動詞，過去式為 won。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: The earthquake ______ at 3 a.m. and ______ many buildings.
questions.explanation: hit 本身過去式不變（三態相同：hit-hit-hit）；destroy 為規則動詞過去式加 -ed → destroyed。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: My parents ______ in Taipei before I ______ born.
questions.explanation: 兩個動作皆在過去，live 用規則過去式 lived；be born 的過去式，主詞 I 搭配 was。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: The boys ______ so much noise that the neighbors ______ the police.
questions.explanation: 整句描述過去發生的事；make 過去式為不規則 made；call 為規則動詞，過去式 called。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 下列「底線處」動詞形式有誤的是哪一項？
options: We ran out of time and didn't finish the test.
She understood the question right away.
They swimmed across the river to escape.
He fell asleep during the movie.
questions.explanation: swim 的過去式為不規則的 swam，而非 swimmed。其他選項：ran（run→ran）、understood（understand→understood）、fell（fall→fell）均正確。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: Anna ______ her phone on the desk, but when she came back, it ______ there anymore.
questions.explanation: leave 的過去式為不規則 left；第二句描述當時的情況，be 動詞過去式否定用 wasn't。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 下列何者「正確」改寫成過去式否定句？
options: She wrote a letter. → She didn't wrote a letter.
They won the game. → They didn't won the game.
He took the bus. → He didn't take the bus.
We sang a song. → We didn't sang a song.
questions.explanation: 助動詞 didn't 後面的動詞必須還原為原形。take 為原形，正確。wrote、won、sang 均非原形（原形應為 write、win、sing）。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
Which sentence correctly uses the past tense?
(A句語意：他昨天讀了這本書。B句語意：我媽媽上週煮了美味的晚餐。C句語意：他們去年輸了比賽。D句語意：她昨晚聽了音樂。)
options: My mother cookt a delicious dinner last week.
They losed the game last year.
She listened to music last night.
questions.explanation: listen 為規則動詞，過去式 listened 正確。read 過去式不變（讀音不同，但拼法同原形，不加 -ed）；cook 過去式為 cooked（不是 cookt）；lose 過去式為 lost（不是 losed）。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: Jason's teacher asked, "Who ______ the window?" But no one ______ a word.
questions.explanation: 兩個動作都在過去；break 的過去式為不規則 broke；say 的過去式為不規則 said。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
根據對話選出時態正確的一項：
A: How did you feel when you ______ the news?
B: I ______ believe it at first.
questions.explanation: A 句 How did you feel 已顯示過去時態，搭配 heard（hear→heard，規則）；B 句表達過去的感受，情態動詞 can 的過去式為 couldn't。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 下列哪組「動詞三態」完全正確？
questions.explanation: cut 屬不規則動詞，三態相同（cut-cut-cut），為正確選項。fly → flew → flown；teach → taught → taught（拼法為 taught 非 tought）；drink → drank → drunk（非 drinked）。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: The store ______ at nine, but we ______ there at ten, so we ______ inside.
questions.explanation: 整段描述過去發生的事：close 規則過去式 closed；get 不規則過去式 got；couldn't go 表達過去無法做某事（can 的過去式否定）。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: 未來式 will 與 be going to
questions.stem: 【情境辨析】Amy says: "Look at those dark clouds! It ______ soon." Choose the best answer.
questions.explanation: 當說話者根據眼前「證據」（烏雲）預測即將發生的事，應使用 be going to，表示有根據的預測。will 通常用於臨時決定或無根據的預測，此處不最適合。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: 未來式 will 與 be going to
questions.stem: 【臨時決定】Peter is on the phone with a friend. His friend says: "I forgot my umbrella and it's raining!" Peter says: "Don't worry! I ______ bring one for you."
questions.explanation: 說話當下才做出的決定（臨時起意），應用 will，表示即時承諾。be going to 用於事先已計畫好的事，此處明顯是聽到消息後才決定，故選 will。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: 未來式 will 與 be going to
questions.stem: 【預先計畫】Which sentence shows a plan made before the moment of speaking?
options: I will answer the phone — it's ringing.
We are going to visit Grandma this weekend. We already booked the tickets.
She will probably like this gift.
They will help us if we ask.
questions.explanation: be going to 強調事先計畫且已有安排（已訂票），選項B符合此用法。其餘選項皆為 will 的典型用法（臨時決定、預測、承諾）。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: 未來式 will 與 be going to
questions.stem: 【否定句辨析】His parents decided last night that they ______ let him go to the concert alone.
questions.explanation: 「昨晚就已決定」代表事先做好的決定，應用 be going to 的否定形式 are not going to。won't 是臨時決定，與「昨晚決定」的語境不符。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: 未來式 will 與 be going to
questions.stem:
【疑問句語境】— "What are your plans for the summer?"
— "I ______ study in a language school in Canada for two months."
questions.explanation: 回答「計畫」類問句時，若是已安排好的計畫，用 be going to 最為自然。will 較偏向當下決定或預測，此處語境是回答暑假計畫，故選 am going to。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: 未來式 will 與 be going to
questions.stem: 【要約/提議】Someone at a dinner table says: "This bag looks heavy. Let me help." The correct form is: "I ______ carry it for you."
questions.explanation: 主動提議幫助他人，且是當場決定的，用 will 表示自願承諾最為恰當。be going to 不適合用於當下的自願提議語境。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: 未來式 will 與 be going to
questions.stem: 【時間副詞搭配】Which sentence is INCORRECT in terms of future tense usage?
options: She is going to graduate next June.
We will call you as soon as we arrive.
They are going to decided to leave tomorrow.
I will finish the report by Friday.
questions.explanation: 選項C中 "are going to decided" 文法錯誤，be going to 後應接原形動詞，應為 "are going to decide"。其餘選項文法皆正確。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: 未來式 will 與 be going to
questions.stem: 【語意辨析：預測 vs 承諾】Choose the sentence where 'will' expresses a PROMISE, not a prediction.
options: It will snow tomorrow according to the forecast.
She will probably win the competition.
I will always be there for you, no matter what.
The package will arrive in three days.
questions.explanation: 選項C「我永遠都會在你身邊」是強烈的承諾（promise），而非預測。選項A、B、D皆是對未來事件的預測（prediction）。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: 未來式 will 與 be going to
questions.stem: 【條件句中的未來式】If it ______ tomorrow, we will cancel the outdoor event.
questions.explanation: 在 if 引導的條件副詞子句中，即使表達未來意義，動詞仍用現在簡單式（rains），主要子句才用未來式（will cancel）。這是英文條件句的固定規則。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: 未來式 will 與 be going to
questions.stem: 【轉述計畫】Tom told his teacher: "I am going to study harder." This means Tom ______ study harder.
questions.explanation: be going to 表示說話前已有的計畫或意圖（prior plan/intention），所以 Tom 是事先就已決定要更用功，而非當下臨時決定。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: 未來式 will 與 be going to
questions.stem:
【情境：電話訂位】A customer calls a restaurant: "I'd like to book a table for six people."
The waiter replies: "Of course! We ______ keep a table for you at 7 p.m."
questions.explanation: 服務人員當場承諾替顧客保留座位，這是即時做出的承諾/決定，用 will 最自然。be going to 通常是說話者本人事先計畫，不適合此服務語境。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: 未來式 will 與 be going to
questions.stem: 【易混淆：will vs be going to in predictions】Which sentence uses 'will' MORE appropriately than 'be going to'?
options: Watch out! That vase is going to fall!
She already bought the dress — she is going to wear it to prom.
Nobody knows for sure, but scientists think there will be life on other planets.
Look at him eat! He is going to finish the whole cake.
questions.explanation: 對於遙遠、不確定的未來做一般性預測，習慣用 will（科學家的推測）。選項A和D有明顯當下可見的證據，選B是有計畫依據，這三種情況用 be going to 更自然。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: 未來式 will 與 be going to
questions.stem: 【未來式與現在進行式】Which sentence correctly uses the present progressive to talk about the future?
options: She is seeing a doctor every morning.
They are flying to Tokyo next Monday. The tickets are already booked.
He is always complaining about his job.
We are knowing the answer soon.
questions.explanation: 現在進行式可用來表示已確定安排的近期未來計畫（選B：機票已訂好）。選A是現在的習慣，選C是批評性現在進行式，選D的 know 是靜態動詞，不用進行式。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: 未來式 will 與 be going to
questions.stem: 【反問/附加問句】"You are going to help me move the furniture, ______ you?"
questions.explanation: 附加問句（tag question）的規則：主要子句用 be going to，附加問句用 be 的相反形式。主句為 "are going to"（肯定），故附加問句用 "aren't you"（否定）。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: Mary is _______ than her twin sister, even though they look almost the same.
questions.explanation: 兩者相比用比較級，outgoing 為多音節形容詞，比較級用 more outgoing。最高級 the most outgoing 用於三者以上，此題只比較兩人，故不適用。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: The new shopping mall is three times _______ as the old one.
questions.explanation: 「倍數 + as + 原級 + as」為固定句型，表示某物是另一物的幾倍大。此題應填 as large，形成 three times as large as 的結構。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: Of all the students in the class, Kevin finished the exam _______ .
questions.explanation: 「of all」暗示三者以上，需用最高級；quickly 是副詞，副詞最高級用 the most quickly。most quick 語法錯誤，應修飾副詞而非形容詞。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: I expected the movie to be boring, but it was _______ than I thought.
questions.explanation: 加強比較級程度用 far / much / even / still + 比較級，故 far more interesting 正確。much most 或 more interesting much 均為錯誤排列。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: The _______ you practice speaking English, the _______ you will become.
questions.explanation: 「the + 比較級…, the + 比較級…」是固定句型，表示「愈…愈…」。兩個空格都需填比較級，故選 more / more confident。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: This problem is _______ difficult than the last one — I solved it in two minutes.
questions.explanation: far less difficult 表示「容易許多（難度低得多）」，以 far 加強 less 的程度。fewer 只修飾可數名詞，least 為最高級，more 則語意相反。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: Among the four seasons, summer is _______ in Taiwan.
questions.explanation: 四季相比屬三者以上，用最高級；hot 為短音節形容詞，最高級加字尾 -est，故為 the hottest（字尾重複子音）。the most hot 錯誤，短形容詞不用 most。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: The twins are good at sports, but neither of them is _______ the other.
questions.explanation: 比較兩者優劣用比較級 better，且比較級後接 than，故為 better than。best 為最高級，不可接 than；best of 用於多者中。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: This is _______ painting I have ever seen in my life.
questions.explanation: 「the + 最高級 + 名詞 + I have ever + 過去分詞」是常見最高級句型。beautiful 為多音節形容詞，最高級用 the most beautiful；beautifulest 並非正確英文。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: My new phone is not _______ my old one — the battery drains much faster.
questions.explanation: 「not as + 原級 + as」表示「不如…」，符合後句電池更耗電的語境。better than 表示「比…好」，語意矛盾。good than 文法錯誤。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: A: Which city in Taiwan has the _______ population? B: New Taipei City does.
questions.explanation: 詢問哪個城市人口最多，需用最高級。population 的多寡搭配 large/small，最高級為 the largest；most large 錯誤，large 為短形容詞，最高級不用 most。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: The weather today is _______ than yesterday, so remember to bring a jacket.
questions.explanation: 比較今日與昨日，需用比較級；cold 為短形容詞，比較級加 -er 成 colder，可用 even 加強，故 even colder 正確。more cold 錯誤，短形容詞不用 more。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: She speaks English _______ her brother, but she is still learning.
questions.explanation: 「not as + 副詞原級 + as」表示「不如…流利」，語法正確。as...than 混用錯誤；not more fluently as 結構錯誤；less fluent 是形容詞，此處需修飾動詞 speaks，應用副詞。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: The book was _______ I had imagined — I finished it in one afternoon.
questions.explanation: 與預想相比，用比較級 shorter；用 much 加強程度；比較級後接 than，故 much shorter than 正確。shorter as 文法錯誤，比較級只能接 than。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: Which sentence uses the superlative correctly?
options: He is the tallest of the three brothers.
She runs the faster in the team.
This is more best idea I've heard.
He is the most tall boy in school.
questions.explanation: 「the tallest of the three brothers」用法正確：三者比較用最高級，tall 為短形容詞加 -est。the faster 應為 the fastest；more best 雙重最高級錯誤；most tall 應為 tallest。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: My grades are getting _______ because I have been studying harder lately.
questions.explanation: 「比較級 + and + 比較級」表示「越來越…」，good 的比較級是 better，故為 better and better。more and more better 重複比較，good and good 不符文法。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
Mrs. Lin is a nurse. She works night shifts and needs to be alert. Which sentence best describes a RULE at her hospital?
(林護士在醫院上夜班，以下哪句最能表達醫院的「規定」？)
options: She can sleep during her shift if she is tired.
She must stay awake and check on patients every hour.
She should probably drink coffee sometimes.
She can leave early when there are fewer patients.
questions.explanation: must 表示強制規定或義務，符合醫院對護士的硬性要求。can 表示許可，should 表示建議，語氣皆不如 must 強烈，不適合描述規定。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
Kevin wants to join the school basketball team. The coach says the tryout is tomorrow but Kevin has never played before. What should Kevin say to the coach?
(Kevin 從沒打過籃球，明天就要選拔，他應該對教練說什麼？)
options: I must play very well tomorrow.
I can practice for three hours right now.
I should tell you that I am a beginner.
I must not join the team at all.
questions.explanation: should 用來表達「應該做某事（建議或道義上的責任）」，此處 Kevin 應該誠實告知教練自己是新手，選項 C 最符合語意。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
Read the sign on the library door: "Silence must be kept at all times." Which sentence has the SAME meaning?
（圖書館門上寫著此標語，哪個句子意思最相近？）
options: You can make some noise if you whisper.
You should try to be quiet when you feel like it.
Everyone must be quiet inside the library.
You can talk loudly only near the entrance.
questions.explanation: 「Silence must be kept」是義務/規定，意思是所有人都必須保持安靜，選項 C 最正確。選項 A、D 允許某些噪音，選項 B 的 should 語氣太弱。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
Amy's doctor told her: "You ______ eat too much sugar. It is bad for your health."
（醫生告誡 Amy 不應攝取太多糖，空格最適合填入？）
questions.explanation: should not 表示建議不要做某事，符合醫生叮嚀語氣。must not 語氣過強，帶有強烈禁止意味；can 則是表示「能力或許可」，不適合此語境。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
Tony is only eight years old. He ______ drive a car — it is against the law.
（Tony 只有八歲，依法他不能開車，空格最適合填入？）
questions.explanation: must not 表示被禁止，強調「絕對不可以」，符合法律上的明確禁止。should not 語氣較弱，只是建議，無法表達法律禁令的強度。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
Which sentence uses "can" correctly to express ABILITY?
（哪個句子正確用 can 表達「能力」？）
options: She can to swim across the lake.
They can finished the work by noon.
My little sister can play the violin very well.
questions.explanation: can 後面必須接原形動詞，且主詞為任何人稱時 can 本身不加 s。選項 A 多了 to，選項 B 錯誤加了 s，選項 C 用了過去分詞，只有 D 形式正確。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
The weather forecast says there might be heavy rain tonight. David is planning to hike in the mountains alone. What is the BEST advice?
（天氣預報說今晚可能暴雨，David 計畫獨自登山，最好的建議是？）
options: You must cancel your hike. The rain is already here.
You should wait until the weather is safer.
You can hike because you are strong.
You must hike early in the morning instead.
questions.explanation: should 用於給予建議，語氣恰當。選項 A 用 must 但「雨已到」與題目不符（題目說 might）；選項 C 忽視危險；選項 D 的 must 過於強制且邏輯不完整。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
Mom says to her son: "You ______ finish your homework before you play video games."
（媽媽告訴兒子，玩電玩之前必須先完成作業，空格最適合？）
questions.explanation: must 表示家長要求的強制義務，比 should（建議）語氣更強，符合「必須先完成才能去玩」的語意。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
Which two sentences are CLOSEST in meaning?
①You should wear a helmet when you ride a bike.
②You must wear a helmet when you ride a bike.
（請選出意思最接近的一對敘述）
options: They mean exactly the same thing.
① is a suggestion; ② is a rule or strong obligation.
① is a rule; ② is only a polite request.
questions.explanation: should 表示建議（應該），must 表示強制義務（必須），兩者雖都勸人戴安全帽，但強度不同。選項 B 正確說明兩者差異。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
Peter: "Look at those dark clouds. It ______ rain soon."
（Peter 看到烏雲，推測快要下雨了，空格最適合？）
questions.explanation: must 可以用來表達對現在情況的高度推測（logical deduction），「看到烏雲→幾乎確定會下雨」適合用 must。can 只表能力，should 是建議，must not 表禁止，均不符。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
The sign at the swimming pool says: "Children under 12 ______ be accompanied by an adult."
（游泳池告示：12歲以下兒童必須有成人陪同，空格最適合？）
questions.explanation: 告示牌上的規定使用 must 最為恰當，表示強制要求。should 語氣太弱（只是建議），can 表許可而非義務，can not 意思相反。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
Grace has a very sore throat. She ______ sing in the concert tonight — her doctor strongly advises against it.
（Grace 喉嚨很痛，醫生強烈建議她今晚不應該上台演唱，空格最適合？）
questions.explanation: should not 表示（根據情況）不應該做某事，符合醫生的建議語氣。must not 語氣更強，帶有禁令意味，但此處是醫生「建議」而非「禁令」，should not 更精確。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
Which sentence is GRAMMATICALLY CORRECT?
（哪個句子文法正確？）
options: She musts go home before dark.
They should to call their parents.
He can speaks English and French.
You must turn off your phone during the exam.
questions.explanation: 助動詞後只能接原形動詞，且 must/should/can 本身不加 s 或 to。選項 A musts 錯誤、選項 B should to 錯誤、選項 C speaks 應為 speak，只有 D 完全正確。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
Situation: You are at a friend's house and you want to use the bathroom. Which is the MOST POLITE way to ask?
（你在朋友家想借用廁所，哪種問法最有禮貌？）
options: I must use your bathroom now.
Can I use your bathroom, please?
You must show me the bathroom.
questions.explanation: Can I...? 是請求許可的常見有禮問法。must 帶有強制或義務語氣，用在此情境顯得無禮；should 是建議語氣，不適合用來請求許可。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
Lisa wants to be a better student. Her teacher gives her three pieces of advice. Which advice uses "should" INCORRECTLY?
（老師給 Lisa 三個建議，哪個 should 使用不正確？）
options: You should review your notes every evening.
You should asking questions when you don't understand.
You should sleep at least eight hours a night.
You should try to read more English books.
questions.explanation: should 後面必須接原形動詞，選項 B 的 asking 應改為 ask，這是最常見的錯誤類型。其餘選項 should + 原形動詞均正確。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
Jason failed his math test three times. His parents and teacher all agree he ______ study harder if he wants to pass.
（Jason 數學考了三次不及格，大家都認為他如果想通過就必須更努力讀書，空格最適合？）
questions.explanation: 此情境強調強烈必要性（不努力就會繼續失敗），must 最為合適。should 雖也可用，但 must 更能強調這是不得不為的義務。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
"You ______ use a dictionary during the test," the teacher told the class. The students were happy.
（老師告訴全班可以在考試時使用字典，學生很高興，空格最適合？）
questions.explanation: can 表示「被允許、許可」，與學生感到高興相符，表示老師允許他們使用字典。must 表義務，must not 和 should not 均為否定，皆與「學生高興」的情緒矛盾。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
Which sentence uses "must" to express LOGICAL DEDUCTION (推論), NOT obligation?
（哪個句子的 must 用來表達推論，而非義務？）
options: You must hand in your report by Friday.
Students must wear uniforms at school.
She must be very tired — she has been working for twelve hours.
We must not enter the lab without permission.
questions.explanation: 選項 C 的 must 是根據「已工作十二小時」的事實來「推論」她一定很累，這是 must 的邏輯推論用法。其餘選項的 must 都表示義務或禁止。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】Mary arrived _____ the airport two hours before her flight.
questions.explanation: 表示「到達某一地點」，airport 是一個特定的地點，應使用介系詞 at。arrive at 用於較小或特定地點（如車站、機場），arrive in 用於城市或國家。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【辨析題】He has been studying _____ three hours without a break.
questions.explanation: for + 一段時間，表示動作持續多長時間；since + 時間點，表示從某時刻開始。這裡 three hours 是一段時間，故用 for。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【變化題】She didn't go to the party _____ she was tired.
questions.explanation: because 引導原因副詞子句，表示「因為」。句意為「她因為累了所以沒去派對」，原因子句用 because，不可用 so（so 引導結果）。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【應用題】Tony wanted to watch TV, _____ his mother asked him to do his homework first.
questions.explanation: but 表示轉折對比，前半句想看電視、後半句媽媽要他先做功課，語意相反，故用 but 連接最為恰當。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】The museum is closed _____ Mondays.
questions.explanation: 表示「在某一天（星期幾）」要用介系詞 on，如 on Monday、on weekends。at 用於時刻，in 用於月份、年份、季節。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【辨析題】_____ it was raining heavily, we decided to stay indoors.
questions.explanation: Since 在此作連接詞，表示「既然、由於」，引導原因子句，後接完整句子。Because of 後接名詞片語，不接子句，故不可選。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【變化題】You should finish your work _____ you can go out and play.
questions.explanation: before 表示「在……之前」，句意為「你應該先完成工作，才能出去玩」。after 表示「在……之後」，語序顛倒則意思不符，此處 before 搭配主句邏輯最通順。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】The children played in the park _____ sunset.
questions.explanation: until 表示「直到某時間點為止」，sunset 是時間點，故用 until。during 後通常接一段時間（如 during the vacation），不接時間點。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【應用題】_____ the bad weather, the outdoor concert was canceled.
questions.explanation: due to 是介系詞片語，後面接名詞或名詞片語（the bad weather），表示「由於、因為」。because 是連接詞，後面必須接完整子句，此處 the bad weather 是名詞片語，故用 due to。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【辨析題】My brother is good at math, _____ I am better at English.
questions.explanation: while 在此作對比連接詞，表示「而（另一方面）」，用來對比兩人的不同特質。so 表結果、because 表原因，皆不符合對比語意。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【變化題】She put the flowers _____ the vase on the table.
questions.explanation: flowers 放入花瓶（vase）中，用 in 表示「在……裡面」。on 表示在表面上，at 表示在某地點，語意皆不符。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】The train leaves _____ 7:30 _____ the morning.
questions.explanation: 時刻前用 at（at 7:30），一天的早/午/晚用 in（in the morning）。兩者皆為固定搭配，不可互換。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【易混淆題】He studied hard _____ he failed the exam.
questions.explanation: but 表示轉折，語意為「他努力念書，但還是考試不及格」，前後語意對比。so 表結果（努力→及格才合理），because 表原因，皆不符合語意。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【辨析題】She was listening to music _____ she was cooking dinner.
questions.explanation: while 引導時間副詞子句，表示「當……的同時」，後接完整子句（she was cooking）。during 後接名詞片語，不接子句，故此處須用 while。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【變化題】The book was written _____ a famous author _____ 1990.
questions.explanation: 被動語態表示「由某人所寫」用 by（by a famous author）；年份前用介系詞 in（in 1990）。這兩個都是固定用法，需同時正確。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】We can either take the bus _____ walk to school.
questions.explanation: either…or… 是固定連接詞組，表示「不是……就是……（二選一）」，此處 or 是 either…or… 結構的一部分，不可替換成其他連接詞。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: Sarah has lived in Taipei ______ she was ten years old.
questions.explanation: since 後面接時間點（she was ten years old），表示從那個時間點持續到現在；for 後面接一段時間長度，用法不同。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: My brother ______ his homework yet. He is still watching TV.
questions.explanation: yet 常與現在完成式否定句連用，表示「尚未完成」的動作。hasn't finished 是正確的現在完成式否定形。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: Look! Someone ______ all the cookies I made this morning.
questions.explanation: Look! 表示對眼前結果的驚嘆，強調過去動作對現在造成的影響（餅乾不見了），應用現在完成式 has eaten。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: Ken: "Have you ever tried durian?" Lisa: "Yes, I ______ it once in Malaysia."
questions.explanation: 回答 Have you ever...? 的問句時，若提供具體的過去時間（once in Malaysia 暗示特定過去經歷），應改用過去式 tried，而非現在完成式。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: The children ______ in the park for two hours. They are very tired now.
questions.explanation: 強調動作從過去持續到現在且仍在進行（現在很累），應用現在完成進行式 have been playing；兩小時的持續狀態使此句最為自然。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: This is the most exciting movie I ______ ever ______.
questions.explanation: 「這是我看過最…的」句型（This is the + 最高級 + that I have ever + p.p.）固定用現在完成式，表示到目前為止的經驗。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: It ______ raining since yesterday afternoon, and the streets are still wet.
questions.explanation: since yesterday afternoon 表示從昨天下午持續到現在，搭配 has been（現在完成式），描述從過去延續至現在的狀態。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: Tony ______ three times, but he still can't open the box.
questions.explanation: three times 在此描述到目前為止嘗試的次數，且後句「still can't open」強調與現在的連結，應用現在完成式 has tried。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: A: "Where is Amy?" B: "She ______ to the library. She'll be back soon."
questions.explanation: has gone to 表示「已經去了（人還在那裡未回來）」；has been to 才是「去過（已回來）」。此題 She'll be back soon 表示她尚未回來，故用 has gone。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: We ______ for the bus for half an hour, but it still hasn't come.
questions.explanation: for half an hour 表示持續等待的時間，且 still hasn't come 強調動作仍在持續，用現在完成進行式 have been waiting 最為貼切。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: Helen is nervous because she ______ never ______ a speech in front of so many people before.
questions.explanation: before 與現在完成式連用，表示「在此之前從未做過某事」的經驗。has never given 是正確的現在完成式否定形式。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: The scientist ______ over 50 papers since she joined the research center in 2010.
questions.explanation: since 2010 表示從 2010 年到現在，動作的結果（論文數量）仍與現在相關，應用現在完成式 has published。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: I can't find my keys. I think I ______ them somewhere in the house.
questions.explanation: 找不到鑰匙是「過去遺失」對「現在」的影響（現在找不到），強調現在結果的狀況，用現在完成式 have lost。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: By the time we arrived at the cinema, the movie ______ already ______.
questions.explanation: 「By the time + 過去式子句」表示在過去某時間點之前已完成，應用過去完成式 had started，而非現在完成式，此題考查兩者的辨別。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: My grandparents ______ married for more than forty years. They are a great couple.
questions.explanation: 描述從過去結婚至今仍持續的狀態，且與現在有關聯，用現在完成式 have been。若用 were，則暗示狀態已結束。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: This is the first time Jason ______ sushi. He looks very excited.
questions.explanation: 「This is the first/second... time + that + S + have + p.p.」是固定句型，用現在完成式表示人生中第一次做某事的經歷。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: A reporter is interviewing a famous chef. Reporter: "______ you ever ______ food for a president?" Chef: "Yes, I have."
questions.explanation: 詢問「有無某種人生經驗」時，用 Have you ever + p.p. 的現在完成式問句；Did you...? 則是問某特定過去時間，語意不同。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: I ______ this novel three times, and I plan to read it again someday.
questions.explanation: three times 表示到目前為止已讀了三次的累積經驗，與現在相關（計畫再讀一次），用現在完成式 have read；read 的過去式雖同形，但此處需完成式語意。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
下列句子何者語法正確？
The new library ______ by the famous architect last year.
questions.explanation: 「圖書館」是被設計的對象，須用被動語態。發生在 last year，故用過去式被動 was designed。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 下列哪一句被動語態的用法「錯誤」？
options: English is spoken in many countries.
The cake was eaten by the children.
A new song has been wrote by Taylor.
The letter will be sent tomorrow.
questions.explanation: write 的過去分詞是 written，不是 wrote。正確句應為 has been written。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
請選出與底線部分語意相近的句子。
Someone stole my bicycle last night.
options: My bicycle was stolen last night.
My bicycle is stolen last night.
My bicycle has been stolen last night.
My bicycle had stolen last night.
questions.explanation: 主動句改被動，時態為過去簡單式，故用 was stolen。last night 是明確過去時間，不搭配完成式。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 下列句子何者表達「這項計畫正在被討論中」？
options: The plan will have been discussed.
questions.explanation: 「正在被討論」是現在進行被動，結構為 is/are being + 過去分詞，故選 is being discussed。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的選項。
By the time we arrived, all the seats ______ already.
questions.explanation: 「在我們抵達之前」座位就已被佔走，表示過去某時點之前已完成，用過去完成被動 had been taken。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 下列哪一句的介系詞使用「正確」？
options: The window was broken with a rock.
The window was broken by a rock.
The window was broken from a rock.
The window was broken to a rock.
questions.explanation: 被動語態中，「使用的工具或手段」用介系詞 with；by 後接「動作的施行者」。一塊石頭是工具，故用 with a rock。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出語意和語法皆正確的句子。
(情境：老師尚未批改試卷)
options: The tests haven't been corrected yet.
The tests weren't been corrected yet.
questions.explanation: 現在完成被動的否定結構為 haven't/hasn't been + 過去分詞，故選 haven't been corrected yet。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 下列句子何者「不能」改寫成被動語態？
questions.explanation: resemble（像）屬於狀態動詞，沒有被動語態。其餘選項都有明確受詞且為動作動詞，可改為被動。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出填入空格後語法正確且語意通順的選項。
"Was the email sent to all the students?" "Yes, it ______ an hour ago."
questions.explanation: 答句回應被動問句，時態為過去式被動，故用 was sent。an hour ago 確認是過去時間點。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
下列哪一句中的被動語態含有雙受詞結構？
(情境：老師把這本書送給了學生)
options: The student was given the book by the teacher.
The book was given by the teacher.
questions.explanation: give 為雙及物動詞，雙受詞結構被動可將間接受詞（the student）提至主詞位置，故 The student was given the book 正確且完整。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的選項。
The injured man ______ to the hospital immediately.
questions.explanation: take 的過去分詞是 taken，過去式被動為 was taken。選項(B)(C)誤用 took，選項(D)結構錯誤。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出語法正確的句子。
(情境：這首歌一直被全世界的人傳唱)
options: This song has been sung all over the world.
This song has been sang all over the world.
This song was being sung all over the world.
This song is sang all over the world.
questions.explanation: sing 的過去分詞是 sung，不是 sang。現在完成被動為 has been sung，表示持續至今的狀態。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
下列何者正確改寫了以下句子？
原句：People believe that exercise is good for health.
options: Exercise is believed to be good for health.
Exercise is believed being good for health.
Exercise believed to be good for health.
It is believed exercise is good for health.
questions.explanation: believe that + 子句，改為被動可寫成 S + is believed + to V 結構，即 Exercise is believed to be good for health。選項(D)缺少連接詞 that，語法不完整。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出填入空格後語法及語意皆正確的選項。
The noise from the construction site ______ by the neighbors every morning.
questions.explanation: complain about 是片語動詞，改被動時 about 不可省略，故正確結構為 is complained about。漏掉 about 則語意不完整。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 下列句子何者表達的時態「不同」於其他三句？
options: The meeting was held last Monday.
The report was finished two days ago.
The windows have been cleaned since morning.
questions.explanation: 選項(C)用的是現在完成式被動（have been cleaned），其餘三句皆為過去簡單被動式（was/were + p.p.）。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合完成對話的選項。
A: Who is going to clean the classroom?
B: Don't worry. It ______ before the principal arrives.
questions.explanation: 教室是被清潔的對象，須用被動語態；表達未來將要完成，用 will be cleaned。主動的 will clean 缺少受詞，語意不完整。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【主格辨析】The scientist ______ discovered the vaccine won the Nobel Prize.
questions.explanation: 先行詞 scientist 為人，且在關係子句中擔任主詞（discovered 的主語），應用 who。which 用於事物；whom 為受格；whose 表所有格後需接名詞。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【所有格應用】The book ______ cover was torn belonged to my sister.
questions.explanation: 空格後緊接名詞 cover，表示所有關係（= the book's cover），應用 whose。which/that 後不直接接名詞表所有；who 用於人。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【受格正式用法】Is she the student to ______ you gave the award?
questions.explanation: 介系詞 to 後面需用受格，且先行詞 student 為人，故用 whom。此為「介系詞 + 關係代名詞」的正式書面語結構。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【可省略判斷】下列哪個句子的關係代名詞可以省略？
options: The dog that bit me ran away.
The girl who is singing is my cousin.
The cake that my mom baked was delicious.
The man whose wallet was stolen called the police.
questions.explanation: 關係代名詞在子句中作「受詞」時可省略。C 選項中 that 是 baked 的受詞（my mom baked the cake），可省略。A、B 的 that/who 為子句主詞不可省；D 的 whose 為所有格不可省。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【非限定子句】My brother, ______ lives in Tainan, is a doctor.
questions.explanation: 非限定關係子句（有逗號隔開）不可用 that；先行詞 brother 為人且作子句主詞，應用 who。whom 為受格，不作主詞。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【地點先行詞辨析】The hotel ______ we stayed last summer has been demolished.
questions.explanation: 先行詞 hotel 為地點，且子句 we stayed 已有完整主詞和動詞，不缺受詞，應用關係副詞 where（= in which）。用 which/that 則子句不完整；in that 不合文法。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【複合關係代名詞】______ you said at the meeting surprised everyone.
questions.explanation: 句首無先行詞，需用複合關係代名詞 what（= the thing that），充當整個主詞子句。What you said = the thing that you said，此為常見進階考點。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【whose 所有格情境題】The singer ______ voice I love is performing tonight.
questions.explanation: 空格後接名詞 voice，表所有關係（= the singer's voice），應用 whose。which/who/whom 後不能直接接名詞表示所有關係。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【不定代名詞先行詞】Anyone ______ wants to join the club should sign up by Friday.
questions.explanation: 先行詞 anyone 雖為不定代名詞，但指人，在子句中作主詞，應用 who。whom 為受格；which 用於事物；whose 為所有格。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【that 不可換 which 的情況】下列哪個句子中 that 不能換成 which？
options: The book that I borrowed was interesting.
This is the only solution that works.
He returned the laptop that he had borrowed.
The movie that we watched was funny.
questions.explanation: 先行詞前有 the only、the very、序數、最高級等強調詞時，關係代名詞必須用 that，不可換成 which。B 選項 the only solution 屬此類，故 that 不可替換。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【受格書面語辨析】The boy ______ you were talking about has just arrived.
questions.explanation: 空格為介系詞 about 的受詞（= you were talking about him），先行詞 boy 為人，正式書面語應用 whom。口語可用 who，但四選項中 whom 最為正確。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【限定 vs. 非限定辨析】下列哪個句子使用了「限定關係子句」且文法正確？
options: My cat, which is black, loves to sleep.
The dog which bit the mail carrier was caught.
My father, who is a teacher, retired last year.
Paris, which is in France, is beautiful.
questions.explanation: 限定關係子句不加逗號，用來辨識特定對象。B 選項無逗號，子句限定了「是哪隻狗（咬郵差的那隻）」，為限定用法且文法正確。A、C、D 均有逗號，屬非限定用法。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【everything 先行詞】Everything ______ he told me turned out to be false.
questions.explanation: 先行詞含 every-（everything、something、anything、nothing）時，必須用 that 而非 which。what 已包含先行詞，不能與 everything 並用；who 用於人。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【文法錯誤辨析】下列哪個句子有文法錯誤？
options: She is the teacher whom all students respect.
He is the man who everyone trusts.
The report which she submitted was excellent.
The artist which painted this picture is famous.
questions.explanation: D 選項先行詞 artist 為人，不可用 which，應改為 who 或 that。A 的 whom 作 respect 的受詞正確；B 的 who 作主格（口語受格亦可接受）；C 的 which 用於事物正確。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【關係代名詞與關係副詞辨析】The city ______ I grew up is no longer the same.
questions.explanation: 先行詞 city 為地點，子句 I grew up 已有完整主詞動詞，不缺受詞，應用關係副詞 where（= in which）。若用 which/that，子句則缺少介系詞 in，形成不完整結構。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境應用：物 + 所有格】I met a boy ______ father is a famous novelist.
questions.explanation: 空格後接名詞 father，表所有關係（= the boy's father），應用 whose，無論先行詞是人或物均可用 whose 表所有。who/which/that 後不直接接名詞表所有格。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【進階辨析：關係代名詞作雙重角色】She is the only student ______ essay was chosen and ______ the teacher praised.
questions.explanation: 第一空格後接名詞 essay，表所有關係，用 whose；第二空格為 praised 的受詞（the teacher praised her），先行詞為人，正式書面語用 whom。本題考查同一先行詞在兩個子句中不同格位的用法。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】Sarah wants to improve her English. Which sentence is grammatically correct?
options: She decided studying harder every day.
She decided to study harder every day.
She decided study harder every day.
She decided for studying harder every day.
questions.explanation: decide 後面須接不定詞（to + V），不可接動名詞或原形動詞。正確用法為 decide to study。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【辨析題】下列句子何者正確？
options: I enjoy to play basketball on weekends.
I enjoy playing basketball on weekends.
I enjoy play basketball on weekends.
I enjoy to playing basketball on weekends.
questions.explanation: enjoy 屬於「只能接動名詞」的動詞，後面須用 V-ing 形式，不可接不定詞。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【應用題】Mary was so tired after school. She said, "I can't wait _____ home and rest."
questions.explanation: can't wait to V 是固定句型，表示「迫不及待做某事」，後面接不定詞。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【辨析題】Tom stopped _____ when he saw his friend crying. He wanted to comfort her.
questions.explanation: stop talking 表示「停止說話」（不再做這件事）；stop to talk 則表示「停下來去說話」。本題語境是 Tom 停下來（停止正在做的事）去安慰朋友，故選 talking。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【變化題】_____ in a big city has both advantages and disadvantages.
questions.explanation: 句子主詞位置可用動名詞（V-ing）或不定詞，但此題選項中只有 Living 文法正確。動名詞作主詞是常見用法。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【易混淆題】Which sentence uses "remember" correctly?
options: Remember to lock the door before you leave. (叮嚀尚未完成的事)
Remember locking the door means you already did it in the past.
I remember to send the email, but I'm not sure if I did.
She remembered calling her mom, so she hasn't done it yet.
questions.explanation: remember to V 表示「記得去做（尚未發生）」；remember V-ing 表示「記得曾做過（已發生）」。選項A語意與文法皆正確，選項C、D語意矛盾。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【應用題】The teacher suggested _____ the chapter again before the exam.
questions.explanation: suggest 只能接動名詞（V-ing），不可接不定詞。suggest reviewing 是正確用法。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】It is important _____ enough water every day, especially in summer.
questions.explanation: It is + 形容詞 + to V 是固定句型，使用「虛主詞 It」，真正主詞為後面的不定詞片語。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【辨析題】My parents don't allow me _____ video games on school nights.
questions.explanation: allow + 人 + to V 是固定句型，表示「允許某人做某事」。不可用 allow + 人 + V-ing。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【變化題】Jenny tried _____ the math problem for an hour but couldn't solve it.
options: Both B and C are correct with different meanings.
questions.explanation: try to V 表示「努力嘗試做（但未必成功）」；try V-ing 表示「試試看做某事（實驗性嘗試）」。兩者文法皆正確但語意不同，本題語境（努力嘗試卻解不出來）符合 try to solve，但選項D說兩者皆正確且語意不同，為最完整答案。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【應用題】Would you mind _____ the window? It's too cold in here.
questions.explanation: mind 後面只能接動名詞（V-ing），Would you mind closing...? 是詢問對方是否介意做某事的禮貌用語。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】The students were excited _____ that their school trip had been approved.
questions.explanation: 形容詞 + 不定詞 表示對某事的情緒反應，be excited to hear 意為「很興奮地聽到」。此為情緒形容詞後接不定詞的用法。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【辨析題】Which sentence is INCORRECT?
options: He gave up smoking for his health.
She avoided to talk about the accident.
They considered moving to a new city.
We practiced speaking English every morning.
questions.explanation: avoid 只能接動名詞，不可接不定詞，故 avoided to talk 是錯誤的，正確應為 avoided talking。其餘三句皆正確：give up、consider、practice 後面都接動名詞。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【變化題】It took Linda two hours _____ the project report.
questions.explanation: It takes + 人 + 時間 + to V 是固定句型，表示「某人花了多少時間做某事」，後面必須接不定詞。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【情境題】My brother is interested in _____ his own business someday.
questions.explanation: 介系詞後面必須接動名詞（V-ing），not 不定詞。be interested in 中的 in 是介系詞，故後接 starting。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【應用題】The coach told the players _____ warming up before the game.
questions.explanation: 不定詞的否定形式為 not to V，tell + 人 + not to V 表示「叫某人不要做某事」。注意 not 放在 to 之前。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 【易混淆辨析題】Choose the sentence that is grammatically correct AND natural in meaning.
options: I forgot buying milk, so I went to the store.
I forgot to buy milk, so I went to the store.
I forgot buying milk, so there was none at home.
I forgot to buy milk, so I had already bought it.
questions.explanation: forget to V 表示「忘記去做（事情還沒做）」；forget V-ing 表示「忘記曾做過（事情已做過）」。選項B語意連貫：忘記去買牛奶→所以去了商店。選項C應用 forgot buying（已買過卻忘記）較合理，但語意稍怪；選項D語意矛盾。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 小明問朋友:「你知道火車幾點到嗎?」下列哪個間接問句寫法正確？
options: Do you know what time does the train arrive?
Do you know what time the train arrives?
Do you know what time the train does arrive?
Do you know what time is the train arriving?
questions.explanation: 間接問句須用直述句語序(主詞+動詞),不可倒裝。「what time the train arrives」為正確語序。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 下列哪一句附加問句使用正確？
options: You have never been to Japan, have you?
You have never been to Japan, haven't you?
You have never been to Japan, did you?
You have never been to Japan, don't you?
questions.explanation: 前句含否定詞 never,視為否定句,附加問句須用肯定形式 have you。助動詞與前句 have 一致。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 老師問學生:「你能告訴我為什麼你昨天缺席嗎?」下列翻譯哪個正確？
options: Can you tell me why were you absent yesterday?
Can you tell me why you were absent yesterday?
Can you tell me why did you absent yesterday?
Can you tell me why you absent yesterday?
questions.explanation: 間接問句中 why 後應接直述句語序「主詞+be動詞」,不可將 were 提前倒裝。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 下列哪一句間接問句語序有誤？
options: I wonder if she likes coffee.
Please tell me where the hospital is.
I don't know how old is he.
She asked whether he would come.
questions.explanation: 「how old is he」是直接問句語序,應改為「how old he is」才符合間接問句規則。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 「那部電影很無聊,不是嗎?」這句話的附加問句哪個正確？
options: The movie was boring, was it?
The movie was boring, wasn't it?
The movie was boring, didn't it?
The movie was boring, isn't it?
questions.explanation: 前句為肯定句且動詞為 was,附加問句取否定並保持同一時態,故為 wasn't it。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: Mary 想禮貌地詢問路人圖書館在哪,下列哪句最自然且語法正確？
options: Could you tell me where is the library?
Could you tell me where the library is?
Could you tell me where does the library is?
Could you tell me where the library does?
questions.explanation: 間接問句以直述句語序表示,「where the library is」正確;選項 A 倒裝錯誤。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 下列哪一個附加問句與前句搭配正確？
options: Let's go for a walk, don't we?
Let's go for a walk, won't we?
Let's go for a walk, shall we?
Let's go for a walk, will you?
questions.explanation: 以 Let's 開頭的祈使句,附加問句固定用 shall we,此為規則特例,需特別記憶。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 下列哪一句的間接問句正確表達「我不確定他是否已經完成作業」？
options: I'm not sure if has he finished his homework.
I'm not sure if he has finished his homework.
I'm not sure if he finished has his homework.
I'm not sure if did he finish his homework.
questions.explanation: if/whether 引導的間接問句,後接直述句語序「主詞+助動詞+動詞」,不倒裝,故「he has finished」正確。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 「請問最近的捷運站在哪裡?」用間接問句詢問陌生人,哪句正確？
options: Excuse me, do you know where is the nearest MRT station?
Excuse me, do you know where the nearest MRT station is?
Excuse me, do you know where the nearest MRT station does?
Excuse me, do you know where does the nearest MRT station?
questions.explanation: 間接問句應用直述句語序。where 後接「主詞(the nearest MRT station)+be動詞(is)」,選項 A 倒裝錯誤。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 「他從不說謊,對吧?」下列附加問句哪個正確？
questions.explanation: never 本身具否定意義,使前句視為否定句,故附加問句用肯定形式 does he。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 下列哪一句能正確回應 「You forgot to call me, didn't you?」 表示「是的,我確實忘了」？
questions.explanation: 附加問句的回答以事實為準,不受問句形式影響。確實忘了,故答 Yes, I did(yes 後接肯定句,陳述忘記的事實)。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 下列句子中,哪一句間接問句的引導語使用最恰當？
options: I want to know that where she comes from.
I want to know where she comes from.
I want to know where does she come from.
I want to know that does she come from where.
questions.explanation: 疑問詞本身已引導名詞子句,不需再加 that;且語序應為「主詞+動詞」,故選 B。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 「這道數學題太難了,你說是嗎?」下列哪個附加問句正確？
options: This math problem is too difficult, is it?
This math problem is too difficult, isn't it?
This math problem is too difficult, doesn't it?
This math problem is too difficult, was it?
questions.explanation: 前句現在式肯定句,附加問句用否定縮寫 isn't it,時態一致且主詞為 it。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 下列哪一個選項正確表達「你知道他們為什麼要搬家嗎?」？
options: Do you know why did they move?
Do you know why they moved?
Do you know why they did move?
Do you know why move they?
questions.explanation: 間接問句中 why 後應接直述句語序「主詞(they)+動詞(moved)」,不可倒裝或加 did。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 「她幾乎不出門,是嗎?」正確的附加問句為何？
options: She hardly goes out, does she?
She hardly goes out, doesn't she?
She hardly goes out, is she?
She hardly goes out, went she?
questions.explanation: hardly 含否定意義,使前句視為否定,附加問句應用肯定形式 does she,與主句時態及助動詞一致。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: Tom 問:「你能告訴我這家餐廳幾點開門嗎?」哪句正確？
options: Can you tell me when does this restaurant open?
Can you tell me when this restaurant opens?
Can you tell me when open this restaurant?
Can you tell me when this restaurant does open?
questions.explanation: 間接問句 when 後須接直述句語序「主詞+動詞」,故為「this restaurant opens」,不可倒裝。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 下列哪一句的附加問句與前句動詞時態不一致（即有誤）？
options: She will join us, won't she?
They finished the project, didn't they?
We should leave now, wouldn't we?
questions.explanation: 前句助動詞為 should,附加問句應為 shouldn't we,不可換成 wouldn't;此為助動詞不一致的錯誤。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 下列哪一句正確且自然地表達「請問你知道這個字怎麼拼嗎?」？
options: Could you tell me how is this word spelled?
Could you tell me how this word is spelled?
Could you tell me how does this word spell?
Could you tell me how spelled this word is?
questions.explanation: 間接問句用直述句語序,被動語態「this word is spelled」正確;選項 A 將 is 提前倒裝故錯誤。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 下列哪一個數不是整數？
questions.explanation: 整數包含正整數、零與負整數，3/4 是分數，不屬於整數。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 在數線上，−3 與 5 之間（不含端點）共有幾個整數？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 數線上距離原點 4 個單位的點，其座標為何？
questions.explanation: 距原點 4 個單位可在原點右側（座標 4）或左側（座標 −4），共兩點。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 下列各數由小到大排列，何者正確？
questions.explanation: 在數線上越往左數值越小，負數中絕對值越大的數越小，故 −5 < −3 < 0 < 2。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: −8 的絕對值是多少？
questions.explanation: 絕對值表示數到原點的距離，恆為非負數，|−8| = 8。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 若一個整數的絕對值為 5，則這個整數有幾個？
questions.explanation: 絕對值為 5 的整數為 5 與 −5，共 2 個。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 在數線上，座標為 −6 的點在座標為 −2 的點的哪一側？
questions.explanation: −6 < −2，在數線上較小的數位於較大的數左側，所以 −6 在 −2 的左側。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 下列敘述何者正確？
options: 負整數的絕對值是負數
正整數的絕對值是負數
任何數的絕對值都大於 0
questions.explanation: |0| = 0，零的絕對值為零本身。其餘選項均有誤。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 數線上，A 點座標為 −4，B 點座標為 3，則 A、B 兩點之間的距離是多少？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 下列哪一個說法正確？
questions.explanation: 0 位於數線正中間，所有負數均在 0 左側，故 0 大於所有負數。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 比較 |−9| 與 |6| 的大小，下列何者正確？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 整數 −10、−1、0、7、−4 中，最大的數是哪一個？
questions.explanation: 在數線上最靠右的數最大，正數 7 大於 0 及所有負數，故最大為 7。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 整數 −10、−1、0、7、−4 中，最小的數是哪一個？
questions.explanation: 負數中絕對值最大的數最小，|−10| = 10 最大，故 −10 最小。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 數線上，從 −3 向右移動 7 格，到達的點座標為何？
questions.explanation: 向右移動表示加法，−3 + 7 = 4，所以到達座標 4 的點。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 數線上，從 5 向左移動 9 格，到達的點座標為何？
questions.explanation: 向左移動表示減法，5 − 9 = −4，所以到達座標 −4 的點。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 若 a 為負整數且 |a| = 6，則 a = ？
questions.explanation: 絕對值為 6 的整數有 6 與 −6 兩個，題目限定 a 為負整數，故 a = −6。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 下列四個數：−5、−3、−8、−1，由大到小排列何者正確？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 下列何者是「−3 的相反數」？
questions.explanation: 一個數的相反數就是在數線上與它距原點相同、方向相反的數，−3 的相反數為 3。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 在數線上，下列哪一個點在 −2 的右側且在 3 的左側？
questions.explanation: 需滿足 −2 < x < 3，選項中只有 1 滿足此條件（−2 < 1 < 3）。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 小明說：「絕對值最小的整數是 1。」這句話是否正確？
options: 正確，因為 1 是最小的正整數
不正確，因為絕對值最小的整數是 0
不正確，因為絕對值最小的整數是 −1
正確，因為負整數的絕對值都大於 1
questions.explanation: |0| = 0，是所有整數中絕對值最小的，所以絕對值最小的整數是 0，小明的說法不正確。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 計算 1/2 + 1/3 的結果為何？
questions.explanation: 通分後，1/2 = 3/6，1/3 = 2/6，相加得 5/6。分母不同時需先取最小公倍數再相加。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 計算 3/4 - 1/6 的結果為何？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 計算 2/5 × 5/8 的結果為何？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 計算 3/7 ÷ 6/14 的結果為何？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 0.25 化成最簡分數為何？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 分數 5/8 化成小數為何？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 計算 1又2/3 + 2又1/4 的結果為何？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 計算 2又1/2 - 1又3/4 的結果為何？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.explanation: 將除數化為整數，2.4 ÷ 0.6 = 24 ÷ 6 = 4，除數與被除數同乘 10。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 下列哪一個分數最大？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 下列哪一個小數最小？
questions.explanation: 比較各位數：整數位皆相同，小數第一位皆為 5，再比小數第二位，0.5 的第二位為 0 最小，故 0.5 最小。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 1/3 的小數表示為循環小數，其循環節為何？
questions.explanation: 1÷3 = 0.333…，小數部分的 3 不斷循環，循環節為 3。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 甲有 3/4 公升果汁，乙有 5/6 公升果汁，兩人共有多少公升？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 一條繩子長 2.5 公尺，裁成每段 0.25 公尺，共可裁幾段？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 下列分數中，哪一個等於 0.375？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 小明每天跑 1又3/4 公里，7 天共跑多少公里？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 計算 0.1 的平方的結果為何？
questions.explanation: 0.1 的平方 = 0.1 × 0.1 = 0.01，兩個小數相乘，小數位數相加共 2 位。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 3/5 和 4/7 哪個較大？兩數差為多少？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 一桶水有 4又1/2 公升，倒出 1又2/3 公升後，剩下多少公升？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 解方程式 2x + 5 = 13，x 的值為何？
questions.explanation: 將 5 移項得 2x = 8，兩邊除以 2 得 x = 4。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 解方程式 3x - 7 = 2，x 的值為何？
questions.explanation: 移項得 3x = 9，兩邊除以 3 得 x = 3。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 解方程式 5(x - 2) = 15，x 的值為何？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 解方程式 x/3 + 2 = 5，x 的值為何？
questions.explanation: 移項得 x/3 = 3，兩邊乘以 3 得 x = 9。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 小明的年齡是小華年齡的 2 倍，兩人年齡相差 8 歲，則小明幾歲？
questions.explanation: 設小華年齡為 x，則小明為 2x，依題意 2x - x = 8，x = 8，小明為 16 歲。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 解方程式 4x + 3 = 2x + 11，x 的值為何？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 解方程式 2(3x - 1) = 4(x + 2)，x 的值為何？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 一個數的 3 倍加上 4 等於該數的 5 倍減去 6，這個數是多少？
questions.explanation: 設這個數為 x，依題意 3x + 4 = 5x - 6，移項得 -2x = -10，x = 5。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 一件衣服打八折後售價為 480 元，原價是多少元？
questions.explanation: 設原價為 x，依題意 0.8 × x = 480，x = 600。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 解方程式 7 - 3x = 1，x 的值為何？
questions.explanation: 移項得 -3x = 1 - 7 = -6，兩邊除以 -3 得 x = 2。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 下列何者是方程式 2x - 3 = 7 的解？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 甲、乙兩數之和為 50，甲數比乙數多 10，則甲數為何？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 解方程式 (x + 1)/2 = (x - 1)/3，x 的值為何？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 一條繩子剪去 1/4 後，剩下 90 公分，原來繩子長幾公分？
questions.explanation: 設繩子原長為 x，剪去 1/4 後剩 3/4，依題意 (3/4) × x = 90，x = 120。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 若 3x + a = 10，且 x = 2，則 a 的值為何？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 兩個連續整數之和為 37，這兩個連續整數中較大的一個是多少？
questions.explanation: 設較小整數為 x，則較大為 x + 1，依題意 x + (x+1) = 37，2x = 36，x = 18，較大整數為 19。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 解方程式 5x - 2(x + 3) = 12，x 的值為何？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 購買 5 枝鉛筆和 2 枝原子筆共花 34 元，若原子筆每枝 7 元，鉛筆每枝幾元？
questions.explanation: 設鉛筆每枝 x 元，依題意 5x + 2 × 7 = 34，5x = 20，x = 4。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 下列方程式中，哪一個的解為負數？
questions.explanation: 解 2x + 6 = 4 得 2x = -2，x = -1，為負數；其餘解均為正數。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 某班同學人數，男生比女生多 6 人，全班共 38 人，則女生有幾人？
questions.explanation: 設女生為 x 人，男生為 x + 6，依題意 x + (x + 6) = 38，2x = 32，x = 16。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 解方程式 3(x + 2) - 2(x - 1) = 11，x 的值為何？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 一個長方形的周長為 36 公分，長比寬多 4 公分，則長為幾公分？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 若 x + y = 7 且 x - y = 3，則 x 的值為何？
questions.explanation: 兩式相加得 2x = 10，故 x = 5。再代入得 y = 2。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 二元一次方程式 2x + y = 8 中，當 x = 3 時，y 的值為何？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 用代入消去法解聯立方程式：y = 2x - 1 且 3x + y = 14，則 x + y 的值為何？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 用加減消去法解：2x + 3y = 12 且 2x - y = 4，則 y 的值為何？
questions.explanation: 兩式相減（第一式減第二式）得 4y = 8，故 y = 2。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 某班男生比女生多 6 人，全班共 38 人。設男生 x 人、女生 y 人，下列哪一個聯立方程式正確描述此情境？
questions.explanation: 全班人數：x + y = 38；男生比女生多 6：x - y = 6。兩式合在一起即為正確聯立方程式。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 解聯立方程式：x + 2y = 10 且 3x - 2y = 6，則 x × y 的值為何？
questions.explanation: 兩式相加得 4x = 16，x = 4，代回第一式得 y = 3，故 x × y = 4 × 3 = 12。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 下列關於二元一次方程式 ax + by = c 的敘述，何者正確？
options: 此方程式只有唯一一組整數解
此方程式在座標平面上的圖形為一條直線
此方程式恰好有兩組解
